blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are rapidly evolving toward continuous audio--visual reasoning, creating an urgent need for evaluations that expose their capability limits. Audio--visual captioning is an ideal diagnostic task, yet current benchmarks face a coupled trade-off: whole-caption scores provide coverage without localization, local probes provide localization without coverage, and unconstrained LLM judges introduce instability. We introduce OmniCapBench (Omni-Video Caption Benchmark), a benchmark that reframes audio--visual caption evaluation as a deep-structured diagnostic framework. OmniCapBench shifts the prediction target from free-form text to sets of atomic, verifiable evaluation units across three tracks: entity references, visual shots, and audio events, enabling reliable scoring with deterministic constraint checks and localized LLM-based semantic comparisons. With 786 densely annotated videos, OmniCapBench effectively distinguishes MLLM perception errors, including temporal grounding failures, identity drift, cross-modal misalignment, and hallucinated descriptions. Evaluating frontier MLLMs reveals strong local perception but weak long-horizon audio--visual reasoning, particularly in identity drift and cross-modal misalignment, providing a fine-grained roadmap for omnimodal development.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大型语言模型(MLLMs)正在迅速向持续的视听推理发展,因此迫切需要暴露其能力限度的评价。 视听字幕是一项理想的诊断任务,然而,目前的基准面临着一种结合的权衡:整封分数提供覆盖而不本地化,局部探测器提供本地化而不覆盖,不受约束的LLM评分带来不稳定. 我们引入了Omni Cap Bench(Omni-Video Caption Basic),这个基准将视听字幕评价重新设定为深层次的诊断框架. OmniCap Bench将预测目标从自由格式文本转换为一组可核查的原子评价单元,跨越三个轨道:实体参考、视觉镜头和音频事件,从而能够用确定性约束检查和本地化的LLM语义比较进行可靠的评分。 Omni Cap Bench在786个注解密集的视频中,有效地区分了MLLM感知错误,包括时间定位故障,身份漂移,跨模式错位,以及幻觉化的描述. 评估前沿的MLLMs揭示了强烈的当地观念,但长视距视听推理薄弱,特别是在身份漂移和跨模式错位方面,为全模式发展提供了精细的路线图。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Comparison of existing evaluation frameworks and the deep-structured evaluation framework. Both (A) Holistic Evaluation and (B) Probe-Based Evaluation derive scores from predicted unstructured, free-form text captions, but introduce distinct limitations. The former uses a global LLM-judge approach that treats the caption as a whole, resulting in an opaque score that masks local errors and lacks granularity, whereas the latter adopts a QA-probe approach to detect local errors but sacrifices global coverage and introduces instability across different LLMs. (C) OmniCapBench (Ours) proposes a deep-structured evaluation framework. The caption is first natively represented as atomic, verifiable audio-visual units. Deterministic rules then verify structural and temporal relationships and dispatch these aligned units to localized, reliable LLMs to perform fine-grained semantic checks. This design preserves comprehensive coverage and achieves fine-grained error localization while eliminating the uncertainty associated with global LLM-based judges.
blocks.zh: 图1:现有评价框架与深层次评价框架的比较。 综合评价(A)和(B)以探测为基础的评价都从预测的无结构、自由形式的文字标题中得分,但引入了明显的限制。 前者采用全球LLM判断方法,将标题作为一个整体对待,导致不透明的分数掩盖了局部错误并缺乏颗粒性,而后者则采用QA-probe方法来检测局部错误,但牺牲了全球覆盖,并给不同的LLMs带来不稳定. (C) Omni Cap Bench(我们)提出了一个结构深厚的评价框架。 标题首先以原生形式作为原子可核查的视听单位。 定时规则然后核查结构和时间关系,并把这些对齐的单位发送到本地,可靠的LLMS进行精细的语义检查. 这一设计保留了全面的覆盖面并实现了精细的误差本地化,同时消除了与基于LLM的全球法官相关的不确定性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are rapidly evolving to reason over continuous audio–visual streams [ 60 , 51 , 49 , 11 , 35 ] . This shift demands a corresponding evolution in evaluation. For representative tasks like audio–visual captioning [ 5 , 62 , 16 ] , assessment must transcend coarse text-quality rankings. In particular, explicitly diagnosing specific capabilities, such as identity tracking, temporal grounding, and audio-visual association, is essential to expose fine-grained weaknesses and provide actionable insights for model improvement.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大型语言模型(MLLMs)正在迅速演变,以超越连续的视听流[60、51、49、11、35]。 这种转变要求评价有相应的演变。 对于具有代表性的任务,如视听标题[5、62、16],评估必须超越粗糙的文本质量排名。 特别是,明确诊断特定能力,如身份跟踪、时间定位和视听联系,对于揭露精细的弱点和为改进模式提供可操作的见解至关重要。

blocks.en: Existing caption benchmarks rarely co-design two tightly coupled components that enable fine-grained and reliable evaluation: the evaluation unit and the scoring operator . The unit determines the granularity of evaluation, whereas the scoring operator governs reliability over units.
blocks.zh: 现有的标题基准很少共同设计两个可以进行精细而可靠的评价的紧密结合的组成部分:评价单位和评分操作员。 单位决定评价的颗粒性,而积分操作员则管辖单位的可靠性.

blocks.en: For the evaluation unit , existing protocols are largely built around the predicted free-form caption, but differ in granularity. Whole-caption protocols treat the predicted–reference caption pair as a single unit ( Figure 1 (A) ) [ 62 , 5 ] , providing broad coverage but compressing fine-grained information into a global scalar that often fails to reveal local errors. Probe-based protocols instead define units as response–ground-truth pairs for question-answering (QA) probes or fact-related cloze tasks ( Figure 1 (B) ) [ 44 , 50 , 29 , 16 ] , thereby accessing localized information within the predicted caption. This enables more localized and specific scoring, but the sparse units lack coverage. For the scoring operator , most existing evaluation approaches employ large language models (LLMs) to assess unstructured text captions, yet systematic efforts to obtain stable and reliable scores remain limited. Specifically, LLMs are required to reason over LLM-generated dense, monolithic text under different evaluation protocols to compute global or local scores, introducing an inverse-engineering process that poses a substantial challenge for reliable judging. In detail, global scoring struggles to align fine-grained details within dense text, whereas local scoring is constrained by the need for accurate information extraction and matching. For instance, QA probes implicitly perform extraction and matching and are thus prone to distraction, which can lead to incorrect conclusions even when the caption is correct (Table 5 ), while event-list scoring explicitly requires post hoc extraction and matching, which can also introduce reliability issues [ 16 ] .
blocks.zh: 对评价单位来说,现有协议主要是围绕预测的自由式标题构建的,但颗粒性不同。 完整封装协议将预测的-引用标题配对作为单个单位(图1(A))[62,5],提供广泛的覆盖,但将精细的信息压缩成一个通常无法显示局部错误的全球分级. 以探测为基础的协议将单位定义为响应 - 用于问答(QA)探针或与事实有关的杂块任务的地-真相对等任务(图1(B)) [44, 50, 29, 16],从而在预测标题内获取本地化信息. 这可以使评分更加局部化和具体化,但人数不多的单位缺乏覆盖。 对评分操作员来说,大多数现有的评价方法都采用大语言模型来评估无结构的文字标题,但取得稳定和可靠的分数的系统努力仍然有限。 具体地说,LLMs需要在不同的评价协议下,通过LLM生成的密集而单一的文本来计算全球或本地分数,引入反向工程过程,对可靠的判断构成巨大的挑战. 详细来说,全球评分在稠密文本中拼接精细的分数细节,而本地评分则受到准确信息提取和匹配需要的限制. 例如,QA探测器含蓄地进行取出和相配,因此容易被分心,即使标题正确,也可能导致错误的结论(表5),而事件列表评分则明确要求事后取出和相配,这也会带来可靠性问题[16].

blocks.en: Consequently, the free-form, monolithic representation of model-generated captions fundamentally obstructs the joint design of the evaluation unit and the scoring operator. First, evaluation units that simultaneously provide global coverage and fine-grained local detail are not explicitly encoded. Second, the scoring operator must perform post hoc extraction prior to scoring, which introduces instability. Together, these limitations lead to additional errors and unreliable evaluation.
blocks.zh: 因此,模型生成的字幕的自由形式、单体代表从根本上阻碍了评价单位和评分操作员的联合设计。 首先,同时提供全球覆盖和精细地方细节的评价单位没有明确编码。 第二,得分操作员必须在得分前进行后取出,这带来了不稳定. 这些限制加在一起导致更多的错误和不可靠的评价。

blocks.en: To close this gap, we propose OmniCapBench (Omni-Video Caption Benchmark), a benchmark that redesigns fine-grained audio–visual captioning around deep-structured evaluation units ( Figure 1 (C) ). More specifically, rather than imposing a superficial format on global text, we decompose the evaluated object into native atomic units. This deep structure breaks the task into discrete, localizable targets, preserving comprehensive video coverage while eliminating the ambiguity of monolithic outputs. Crucially, it enables a reliable scoring operator: deterministic rules rigorously verify structural relationships, while LLMs are restricted to bounded semantic comparisons, avoiding the compounding uncertainty of unconstrained text-level judgments.
blocks.zh: 为了缩小这一差距,我们提出了Omni Cap Bench(Omni-Video Caption基准),这个基准围绕结构深厚的评价单位重新设计精细的视听字幕(图1(C))。 更具体地说,我们不是将表面格式强加给全球文本,而是将评估对象分解成原生原子单位。 这种深层结构将任务分解为离散的,可本地化的目标,保留了全面的视频报道,并同时消除了单一产出的模糊. 关键是,它能够使一个可靠的评分操作员:确定性规则严格验证结构关系,而LLMs则仅限于有界限的语义比较,避免了不受约束的文本级判断的复杂不确定性.

blocks.en: In practice, OmniCapBench operationalizes this structure via three native evaluation tracks. The Reference track catalogs persistent scenes and subjects, while the Event track captures timestamped audio occurrences. Crucially, the Shot track segments visual content, using explicit cross-links to temporally ground both references and events. This track design drives a two-stage scoring pipeline. First, deterministic rules and a bounded LLM matcher verify structural integrity, including valid IDs, temporal bounds, and cross-links. Second, localized LLMs exclusively assess the semantic equivalence of these isolated fields. By enforcing this strict scoring contract, OmniCapBench elevates coarse text evaluation into a fine-grained diagnostic tool. Table 1 examines whether existing benchmarks natively support such verifiable atomic units.
blocks.zh: 实际上,Omni Cap Bench通过三个本土评价轨道使这一结构投入运作。 参考音轨目录为持久性场景和主题,而事件音轨则捕捉有时间戳的音频出场. 关键的是,Shot轨道将视觉内容分解,使用清晰的交叉链接对参考和事件进行分解。 这条跑道设计驱动了两阶段的打分管. 首先,确定性规则和一个有界限的LLM匹配器验证结构完整性,包括有效的ID,时间界限,以及交叉链接. 第二,地方性有限责任公司专门评估这些孤立领域的语义等同性。 Omni Cap Bench通过执行这项严格的评分合同,将粗糙的文字评价提升为精细的诊断工具. 表1审查现有基准本身是否支持这种可核查的原子单位。

blocks.en: Table 1 : Evaluation paradigm comparison. We compare whether existing protocols natively support the structural dimensions of omnimodal diagnosis. Identity Tracking explicitly evaluates entity permanence across discontinuous shots (Visual). Temporal Grounding enforces precise continuous time boundaries for actions and sounds (Audio/Visual). Audio-Visual Association evaluates whether audio events are correctly attached to concurrent visual shots (Audio-Visual). Diagnostic Traceability indicates whether the evaluation isolates explicit structural breakdowns from descriptive hallucinations. ✓ : natively supported as a verifiable unit; △ \triangle : implicitly judged; ✗ : not supported.

blocks.en: To validate OmniCapBench, our experiments proceed in three parts. First, we establish a capability benchmark for state-of-the-art omnimodal models, decoupling evaluation into deterministic rules (Table 3 ) and bounded semantic checks (Table 4 ) to pinpoint localized bottlenecks. Second, we audit the holistic evaluation paradigm across models, metrics, and generation formats (Table B.7 ), demonstrating that global text-level scores mask local errors and reward structurally flawed outputs. Finally, by contrasting weak and strong LLM judges (Table 5 ), we show that global, unlocalized LLM scoring induces unstable conclusions, confirming the necessity of our decoupled framework.
blocks.zh: 为了验证Omni Cap Bench 我们的实验分三部分进行 首先,我们为最先进的全方位模型制定能力基准,将评价与确定性规则脱钩(表3)和确定局部瓶颈的限定语义检查(表4)。 第二,我们审计各种模型、衡量尺度和生成格式的综合评价范式(表B.7),表明全球文本级别得分掩盖了当地的错误并奖励结构有缺陷的产出。 最后,通过对比弱而强的LLM评分(表5),我们表明,全球的、未本地化的LLM评分会导致不稳定的结论,确认我们脱钩的框架的必要性。

blocks.en: Our contributions are three-fold: (i) We propose a Deep-Structured Evaluation Paradigm that decomposes audio–visual captioning into atomic, verifiable units, explicitly isolating semantic content, temporal grounding, identity tracking, and cross-modal association. (ii) We instantiate this paradigm into the OmniCapBench Benchmark , a rigorous testbed comprising 786 densely annotated videos. Its native Reference, Shot, and Event tracks yield 5,818 entities, 6,537 audio events, and 11,419 visual shots to evaluate fine-grained omnimodal comprehension. (iii) We conduct an Empirical Audit of Holistic Scoring , exposing its vulnerability to judge instability and tendency to mask localized errors, thereby demonstrating the necessity of deep-structured metrics.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三重:(一) 我们提出了一个深层评估范式,将视听标题分解为原子、可核查的单位,明确隔离语义内容、时间定位、身份跟踪和跨模式联系。 (二) 我们立即将这一范式纳入Omni Cap Bench基准,该基准是一个严格的测试台,由786个内容密集的带宽视频组成。 其本土参考、射击和事件跟踪共产生5 818个实体、6 537个音频事件和11 419个视觉镜头,以评估精细的全方位理解。 (三) 我们对综合分类进行实证审计,揭示其易于判断不稳定性和掩盖局部错误的倾向,从而表明深层结构计量标准的必要性。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Omnimodal large language models are rapidly advancing toward reasoning over continuous audio–visual streams [ 51 , 1 , 48 , 49 , 32 , 24 , 28 , 64 , 52 , 33 , 13 , 34 , 6 , 10 , 15 , 30 , 55 ] . Accelerated by reinforcement learning and multi-agent systems [ 65 , 63 , 46 , 9 , 54 , 56 , 42 , 61 , 57 , 58 ] , audio–visual captioning has become a foundational task requiring the synthesis of visual, motion, and acoustic signals. While broad video benchmarks [ 12 , 21 , 40 , 39 , 66 , 20 , 17 , 53 , 47 , 41 , 19 ] track general progress, they often reduce complex behaviors to coarse text-level scores, lacking the diagnostic resolution needed to pinpoint localized audio–visual failures.
blocks.zh: Omnimodule大型语言模型正在迅速向连续视听流的推理发展[51、1、48、49、32、24、28、64、52、33、13、34、6、10、15、30、55]。 通过强化学习和多代理系统[65,63,46,9,54,56,42,61,57,58]加速,视听字幕已成为一项基础任务,需要综合视觉,运动,和声信号. 虽然广义的视频基准[12, 21, 40, 39, 66, 20, 17, 53, 47, 41, 19] 追踪总体进展,但它们往往会降低复杂的行为来粗略地降低文本级别的分数,缺乏识别本地视听故障所需的诊断分辨率.

blocks.en: Moving beyond legacy metrics [ 37 , 2 , 26 , 18 ] , recent protocols explore different evaluation units. Holistic evaluation scores full captions across dimensions [ 62 , 5 , 27 , 8 , 43 , 23 ] , yet treating text as a monolithic unit masks specific temporal or relational errors. QA and temporal probes [ 44 , 50 , 29 , 4 , 25 , 38 ] localize errors via explicit questions but suffer from sparse coverage. Other methods parse free-form text into script items [ 16 , 59 , 31 , 7 , 14 ] , treating structure as a fragile post-hoc extraction layer. Crucially, when an LLM acts as a global judge—simultaneously parsing unstructured text, resolving references, and tracking time—these entangled tasks conflate factual hallucinations with stylistic variations, leading to unreliable scoring.
blocks.zh: 超越了遗留的衡量标准[37,2,26,18],最近的协议探索了不同的评价单位. 整体评价在全尺寸[62, 5, 27, 8, 43, 23] 评分满分, 但将文本作为单词单位掩盖特定的时间或关系错误。 质量保证和时间探测器[44、50、29、4、25、38]通过明确的问题确定出错的地方,但覆盖面很少。 其他方法将free-form文本分解为脚本项目[16,59,31,7,14],将结构作为脆弱的后热取层. 关键的是,当一个LLM充当一个全球法官时——最强烈地解析出无结构的文本,解决引用,以及跟踪时间——这些纠缠的任务将事实幻觉与结构变化相混淆,导致不可靠的评分.

blocks.en: In short, existing methods face a strict tradeoff: they either sacrifice coverage for localization, or rely on opaque LLM judgments that obscure fine-grained errors. OmniCapBench resolves this tension through deep-structured evaluation . By mandating models to output native, atomic audio–visual units, our framework achieves both comprehensive coverage and exact localizability. Furthermore, we decouple the scoring process: deterministic probes verify structural relationships, while reliable localized LLMs are strictly bounded to local semantic checks. This eliminates the compounding uncertainty of global LLM judges, yielding a highly reliable diagnostic signal.
blocks.zh: 简言之,现有方法面临严格的取舍:它们要么牺牲本地化的覆盖,要么依靠模糊了细微错误的不透明的LLM判断. Omni Cap Bench通过深层结构评价解决了这种紧张关系。 通过授权模式输出原生的、原子的视听单位,我们的框架实现了全面的覆盖和准确的可本地化。 此外,我们取消了评分程序:确定性探测器核实结构关系,而可靠的本地LLMS则严格限于本地语义检查。 这消除了全球LLM法官的复杂不确定性,产生了非常可靠的诊断信号.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : OmniCapBench data construction pipeline. The construction proceeds in three stages. Stage I filters raw videos to isolate inputs with rich audio–visual complexity. Stage II generates atomic units (References → \rightarrow Events → \rightarrow Shots) through an iterative multi-model loop, enforcing structural integrity before semantic refinement. Stage III applies traceable human audits to finalize the rigorously verified audio–visual reference system.

blocks.en: 3 OmniCapBench Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3 Omni Cap Bench 基准

blocks.en: To establish a fine-grained, reliable evaluation standard for omnimodal foundation models, we introduce the OmniCapBench benchmark. We first present the data construction pipeline (Section 3.1 ), which converts raw videos into well-defined, verifiable atomic units. We then outline the evaluation goals and diagnostic task suite built on this structured representation (Section 3.2 ).
blocks.zh: 为了制定精细可靠的全模式基础模型评价标准,我们采用了OmniCap Bench基准。 我们首先介绍数据构建管道(第3.1节),将原始视频转换为定义明确、可核查的原子单元。 然后,我们概述了评价目标和基于这种结构化代表性的诊断任务组合(第3.2节)。

blocks.en: 3.1 Data Construction and Native Track Generation
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 数据构建和原生轨道生成

blocks.en: From an evaluation standpoint, rigorously verifying an AI’s audio–visual understanding requires isolating what happened from when and where it occurred. To achieve this fine-grained diagnostic evaluation, we inherently require a structured representation that systematically decouples distinct video elements, such as entities, auditory events, and visual states. The Multi-Stream Scene Script (MTSS) [ 36 ] naturally provides this factorized foundation, making it an ideal fit for our evaluation objectives. Therefore, we build OmniCapBench upon MTSS, adopting its core decoupled design to independently track these information streams. To fully support precise benchmarking, we further optimize its coarse-grained limitations: specifically, we decompose visual shots into finer subshots and replace discrete point timestamps with continuous time ranges .
blocks.zh: 从评价的角度来看,严格核实AI的视听理解需要将所发生的事情从何时何地分开。 为了实现这一精细的诊断评价,我们必然需要一种结构化的表述方式,系统地将不同的视频要素脱钩,如实体、听觉事件和视觉状态。 多层场景脚本(MTSS)[36]自然提供了这种被要素化的基础,使其成为适合我们评价目标的理想. 因此,我们在MTSS上建立了Omni Cap Bench,采用其核心脱钩设计,独立跟踪这些信息流。 为了充分支持精确的基准,我们进一步优化其粗糙的受压限制:具体地说,我们把视觉镜头分解成更细的子镜头,并用连续时间范围取代离散点时标。

blocks.en: For a given video V V , we formalize its content into a structured representation 𝒮 ⋆ ​ ( V ) = ( ℛ , ℰ , ℋ ) \mathcal{S}^{\star}(V)=(\mathcal{R},\mathcal{E},\mathcal{H}) . To guarantee structural integrity, this representation is built across three interdependent tracks: • References ( ℛ \mathcal{R} ): This track establishes persistent identities for key entities, including people, objects, and scenes, by assigning unique identifiers that enable consistent tracking of each entity throughout the video. • Events ( ℰ \mathcal{E} ): This track isolates auditory events and spoken dialogue together with their precise temporal boundaries, for example, extracting a continuous dog bark from 10.5s to 12.0s. • Shots ( ℋ \mathcal{H} ): This track segments the visual timeline into discrete camera shots and serves as the unifying structure by anchoring previously defined entities and audio events to specific frames, for example, linking the barking sound to the shot that shows the dog.

blocks.en: Stage I: Candidate Curation. We source candidate videos from diverse open datasets and public platforms. Following initial preprocessing (e.g., metadata extraction, shot detection, and categorization), we apply rigorous filtering based on audio presence, duration, quality, and bucket-specific density (Appendix A.1.1 ). This curation ensures all retained videos exhibit sufficient audio–visual complexity to warrant our multi-unit structural evaluation, directly supporting our goal of probing deep omnimodal reasoning rather than isolated single-event recognition.
blocks.zh: 第一阶段:候选人说明。 我们从各种开放数据集和公共平台源出候选视频. 在初步预处理(例如元数据提取,镜头检测和分类)后,我们根据音频存在,持续时间,质量,以及桶特有密度(附录A.1.1.)实施严格的过滤. 我们的多单元结构评价, 直接支持我们探究深度全方位推理而不是孤立的单一事件的目标。

blocks.en: Stage II: Native Track Construction. As defined previously, this stage iteratively builds the atomic units in the required dependency order ( ℛ → ℰ → ℋ \mathcal{R}\rightarrow\mathcal{E}\rightarrow\mathcal{H} ).
blocks.zh: 第二阶段:土道建设. 如前所定义,此相位迭代地按照所需的依赖顺序构建原子单位(R → E → H \ mathcal{ R}\-右arrow- mathcal{ E}\-右arrow- mathcal{H}).

blocks.en: To autonomously guarantee structural integrity during data generation, we execute an iterative Local Refinement loop: Generate → \rightarrow Evaluate & Validate → \rightarrow Local Refine → \rightarrow Select . First, a generator proposes initial candidate tracks for the video. Next, an evaluator ensemble checks the factual accuracy of these candidates, while a programmatic validator rigorously enforces schema constraints, triggering automatic regeneration or discarding of invalid outputs. Crucially, once the foundational topology is validated, a local refinement step enriches the textual descriptions. During this process, the underlying structure, such as entity identifiers, temporal boundaries, and cross-links, remains strictly invariant. This constrained refinement explicitly prevents linguistic enhancements from introducing new hallucinations or corrupting the already verified topology. Finally, a selector model chooses the highest-quality refined version to form the final canonical tracks. Note that the frames used in this stage carry a red timestamp overlay purely as an annotation aid; evaluated models always receive the original frames without it (Appendix A.1.1 ).
blocks.zh: 为了在数据生成过程中自主保证结构完整性,我们执行一个迭代的"局部精华"循环:生成 →\右旋评价与验证 →\右旋局部精华 →\右旋选择 . 首先,一个生成器为视频提出了初步候选音轨. 接下来,一个评价员小组检查这些候选人的事实准确性,而一个方案验证员严格执行计划限制,触发自动再生或丢弃无效产出。 关键是,一旦基础地貌得到验证,一个局部的完善步骤会丰富文字描述. 在这一过程中,实体识别特征、时间界限和交叉链接等基础结构仍然严格不变化。 这种受限的完善明确阻止了语言增强,从而无法引入新的幻觉或腐蚀已经得到验证的地貌. 最后,一个选取器模型选择出质量最高的精制版来组成最终的克能道. 请注意,这一阶段使用的相框上挂有红色的时间戳,纯粹是作为注解辅助;被评价的相框总是在没有它的情况下收到原始相框(附录A.1.1.).

Because the native reference system 𝒮 ⋆ ​ ( V ) \mathcal{S}^{\star}(V) directly dictates the evaluation scoring contract, its data integrity must be audited before scoring claims are reported. In this final stage, programmatic validators inspect schema validity, timestamp ranges, and cross-links, while targeted human audits inspect boundary and semantic disagreements. The finalized units provide each video with a reliable reference system 𝒮 ⋆ ​ ( V ) = ( ℛ , ℰ , ℋ ) \mathcal{S}^{\star}(V)=(\mathcal{R},\mathcal{E},\mathcal{H}) for model evaluation.

blocks.en: 3.2 Evaluation Goals and Task Suite
blocks.zh: 3.2 评价目标和任务套件

blocks.en: The overarching goal of the OmniCapBench benchmark is to evaluate omnimodal foundation models with high granularity and reliability . Instead of using an unconstrained text-centric generation process that inherently conflates a model’s true audio–visual comprehension with its language style, OmniCapBench derives its diagnostic tasks directly from the rigorous native reference system 𝒮 ⋆ ​ ( V ) \mathcal{S}^{\star}(V) . Appendix A.1.1 details the exact input–output formats.
blocks.zh: Omni Cap Bench基准的总体目标是评价具有高颗粒性和可靠性的全模式基础模型。 Omni Cap Bench没有使用一种不拘一格的以文字为中心的生成过程,这种过程从本质上将模型的真正视听理解与语言风格相融合,而是直接从严格的本土参考系统S-⋆ (V)\ mathcal{S-}^{\star} (V)中得出诊断任务。 附录A.1.1详细列出了准确的输入-输出格式。

blocks.en: Task 1: Native Unit Generation. In this primary task, a model takes a video V V and directly outputs the three prediction tracks (References, Shots, and Events) as a structured JSON object. Instead of writing a free-form paragraph, the model must explicitly construct the set of atomic units 𝒮 ^ ​ ( V ) \hat{\mathcal{S}}(V) . This forces the model to expose its internal reasoning in a highly structured format, directly aligning with our goal of fine-grained evaluation and removing the ambiguity of free-form text. We use this task to assess state-of-the-art models and quantify their structural and semantic accuracy.
blocks.zh: 任务1:土著单元生成。 在这个主要任务中,一个模型取出一个视频VV并直接输出出三个预测轨道(References, Shots, and Events)作为结构化的JSON对象. 该模型不是写出自由形式的段落,而是必须明确构建原子单位S ^ (V)\hat'mathcal{S}}(V). 这迫使模型以高度结构化的格式暴露其内部推理,直接符合我们精细评价的目标并消除了自由格式文本的模糊. 我们利用这项任务来评估最先进的模型并量化其结构和语义准确性.

blocks.en: Task 2: Structural Verification and Matching. Before semantic scoring, we first check whether each predicted unit is structurally valid. A valid unit must use defined identifiers, have a well-formed time span, and link only to existing and temporally compatible references, shots, or events. Predictions that violate these rules, such as undefined IDs, reversed start–end times, or impossible event–shot links, are removed by deterministic checks. We then match the remaining units to the ground truth. Shots and events are matched by temporal intersection-over-union (tIoU), while identity references and visual subshots are matched with a bounded LLM-assisted matcher that only compares local candidate pairs. This design separates structure from semantics: invalid or unmatched units are counted as structural errors, and the LLM scorer is used only on aligned unit pairs. Thus, errors such as invalid IDs, weak temporal overlap, or wrong event–shot links become traceable structural deficits rather than hidden components of a single caption-level score.
blocks.zh: 任务2:结构核查和匹配。 在语义评分前,我们首先检查每个预测的单位在结构上是否有效. 一个有效的单位必须使用定义的标识符,具有一个完善的时间跨度,并且只链接到现有的和时间上相容的引用,镜头或事件. 违反这些规则的预测,如未定义的ID,倒转起止时间,或不可能的事件快照链接,通过确定性检查被删除. 然后我们把剩下的部队 与地面真相匹配 镜头与事件相匹配的是时间相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接 这种设计将结构从语义学中分离出:无效或未匹配的单元被算作结构错误,而LLM计分器只在对齐的单元对上使用. 因此,无效的ID、弱的时间重叠或错误的事件-shot链接等错误会变成可追踪的结构缺陷,而不是单一标题级分数的隐藏部分。

blocks.en: Task 3: Localized Semantic Scoring. In the final stage, we dispatch the matched unit pairs to an LLM judge. With structural complexities (e.g., timing and identity tracking) already resolved in Task 2, the LLM is strictly bounded to perform local semantic equivalence comparisons on isolated content fields. This “structure-first, semantics-second” approach isolates genuine descriptive fidelity from structural noise. Crucially, by decomposing the evaluation into deep-structured atomic units, the assessment becomes significantly simpler. This substantially reduces the dependency on advanced LLM reasoning capabilities, ensuring highly objective and reliable results.
blocks.zh: 任务3:本地化语义分解. 在最后阶段,我们发送匹配的单元对 对一个LLM法官。 在结构上的复杂性(如时间和身份跟踪)在"任务2"中已经解决了,LLM被严格限定在孤立的内容字段中进行本地语义等同比较. 这种“结构第一,语义第二”的方法将真正的描述忠诚与结构噪声隔离开来。 关键的是,通过将评价分解成深层结构原子单位,评估变得明显地简单. 这大大减少了对高级LLM推理能力的依赖,确保了高度客观和可靠的结果.

blocks.en:
Bidirectional Evaluation: Precision vs. Recall. Because open-ended video generation lacks a perfect one-to-one mapping between predictions and human annotations (for instance, a model might decompose a visual action into three dense subshots while the ground truth summarizes it in one), evaluating from a single direction is inherently biased. For open-vocabulary and continuous fields like References (Subject and Scene) and Subshots, OmniCapBench enforces a bidirectional matching and scoring paradigm. Specifically, we execute the matching and scoring processes from two distinct perspectives with different focuses:
(1) The Recall Perspective (Ground Truth → \rightarrow Prediction) uses the ground truth as the subject to check if the prediction covers it, strictly penalizing omissions .
(2) The Precision Perspective (Prediction → \rightarrow Ground Truth) uses the prediction as the subject to check if the ground truth supports it, strictly penalizing hallucinations .
The final F1 scores for categories like Subshot F1 are directly derived by computing the harmonic mean of these two distinct directional metrics. In our reporting, Ref Subject encompasses both persons and objects, while Ref Scene corresponds to scene references. This prevents models from gaming the evaluation through overly terse responses (which would fail recall) or excessively verbose, speculative dumps (which would fail precision). Appendix A.2.2 provides extensive details on this mechanism.
blocks.zh:
双向评价:精度与回忆. 因为开放式的视频生成缺乏在预测和人类说明之间完美的一对一的映射(例如,一个模型可能会将一个视觉动作分解为三个密集的子镜头而地面真象将其概括为一),从一个方向来评价是内在的偏颇. 对于开放-vocabulary和连续字段,如参考文献(Subject and Scene)和Subshots,Omni Cap Bench执行双向匹配和分数范式. 具体地说,我们从两个不同的角度执行配对和评分过程,并有不同的重点:
(1) 《回顾展望》(Ground Truth ~ \rightarro Presidency)将地面真相作为检查对象,以严格惩罚遗漏。
(2) 精密透视(President →\raightar Ground Truth)以预测为主体,检查地上真实是否支持,严格惩罚幻觉.
Subshot F1等类别的最终F1分数通过计算这两个截然不同的方向度量的口号平均值直接推算出. 在我们的报告中,Ref Object 既包括人也包括物体,而Ref Scene 符合现场参考。 这使得模型无法通过过度微小的回复(无法召回)或过度的动词、投机性倾销(无法精确)来进行评价。 附录A.2.2详细介绍了这一机制。

blocks.en:
Structured Diagnostic Metrics. OmniCapBench provides a suite of deterministic metrics designed to expose specific structural vulnerabilities, moving beyond holistic text similarity. Exact formulations are detailed in Appendix A.2.2 .
In the Visual domain, Reference Subject/Scene F1 evaluate basic entity detection, while Reference Use (RefUse) and Cross-Shot Coreference Consistency (CCC) check identity permanence across video cuts. For temporal grounding, Shot/Subshot F1 and tIoU measure the recovery and boundary alignment of visual states.
In the Audio domain, Event F1 and tIoU verify the recovery and precise temporal alignment of sound events.
In the Audio-Visual domain, Event-Shot Association F1 (EVSA) measures whether audio events are correctly attached to concurrent visual shots, while Speaker F1 verifies that dialogue is assigned to the correct visual speaker.
Finally, Localized Semantic metrics (bounded Precision and Recall ) quantify descriptive fidelity strictly on structurally valid units. This isolates factual comprehension from structural noise, preventing models from masking hallucinations or omissions behind fluent prose.
blocks.zh:
结构诊断计量。 Omni Cap Bench提供了一套确定性衡量标准,旨在暴露具体的结构脆弱性,超越整体文本的相似性。 确切的制剂详见附录A.2.2.。
在视觉领域,Reference object/Scene F1评价基本实体检测,而Reference Use(Refuse)和Cross-Shot CoReference Consistency(CCC)则通过视频剪切检查身份的持久性. 对于时间定位,Shoot/Subshot F1和tIoU测量可视状态的恢复和边界对接.
在音频领域,Evention F1和tIoU验证了声音事件的恢复和精确的时间对接.
在视听领域,Event-Shot Association F1(EVSA)衡量音频事件是否正确附着在并发的视觉镜头上,而发言人F1则验证对话分配给了正确的视觉扬声器.
最后,本地化的语义计量(限定的精度和回想)严格按照结构上有效的单位量化描述的忠诚度。 这将事实理解与结构噪声隔离开来,防止了模型掩盖出幻觉或流利道词背后的遗漏.

blocks.en: Metrics and Results Format. Following Section 3.2 , our deep-structured evaluation reports fine-grained metrics across Visual (RefUse, CCC, Ref Subject/Scene F1, Shot/Subshot F1 and tIoU), Audio (Event F1 and tIoU), and Audio-Visual domains (Speaker F1 and EVSA F1). Table 3 presents the rule-based match scores, while Table 4 separately reports semantic equivalence scores computed only on structurally valid and aligned units.

blocks.en: 4.2 Benchmarking Omnimodal Model Capabilities
blocks.zh: 4.2 制定模拟模型能力基准

blocks.en: Table 3 reports the performance of evaluated models across the rule-based metric families. By shifting from global scalar text scores to deep-deep-structured evaluation units, we can pinpoint where models fail in fine-grained audio–visual comprehension. Table 4 reports the corresponding bounded LLM-as-judge semantic scores on aligned units.
blocks.zh: 表3汇报了所有基于规则的计量系统评价模型的业绩。 通过从全球标本评分向深层结构评价单位转变,我们可以确定模型在精细的视听理解方面失败之处。 表4汇报了对等单位相应的LLM-as-judge语义分数。

blocks.en: Our deep-structured evaluation exposes critical capability deficits that holistic text scores typically obscure. By decoupling evaluation into deterministic structural rules (Table 3 ) and bounded semantic checks (Table 4 ), we pinpoint three fundamental bottlenecks in current omnimodal models.
blocks.zh: 我们的深层次评价暴露出关键的能力缺陷,而整体文本的得分通常模糊不清。 通过将评价与确定性结构规则(表3)和定界语义检查(表4)脱钩,我们确定了当前全方位模型的三个基本瓶颈。

blocks.en: First, in the visual domain, OmniCapBench shifts the focus from isolated entity recognition to continuous identity tracking. While frontier models like Gemini 2.5-Pro exhibit strong basic perception (84.80% Ref Subject F1 on < 1 <1 min videos, Appendix Table B.5 ), their ability to track these identities across cuts degrades sharply. This is captured by the Cross-Shot Coreference Consistency (CCC) score, which drops to 37.81% for Gemini 2.5-Pro and collapses below 12% for open-source models. The insight is clear: current architectures struggle with long-term visual object permanence, a deficit hidden by traditional metrics that only check if an object was mentioned once.
blocks.zh: 首先,在视觉领域,Omni Cap Bench将焦点从孤立的实体识别转移到持续的身份跟踪. 虽然双子座2.5-Pro等前沿模型表现出强烈的基本感知(84.80%的Ref object F1在 < 1 < 1分钟视频上,附录表B.5),但它们在切口之间跟踪这些身份的能力急剧下降。 这被"跨Shot CoReference Consistency"(CCC)分数所俘获,双子座2.5-Pro的分数降至37.81%,而开源模型的分数则低于12%. 洞察力是明确的:当前的建筑与长期视觉物体的持久性相抗衡,这种缺陷被传统的度量衡所隐藏,它只检查一个物体是否曾被提及一次.

blocks.en: Second, in the audio and cross-modal domains, our structural metrics reveal a persistent modality disconnect. While models excel at speech transcription (Dialogue semantics ≥ 80 % \geq 80\% ), their auditory reasoning for environmental sounds remains weak. More critically, genuine omnimodal comprehension requires structurally binding these sounds to concurrent visual sources. However, Gemini 3.1-Pro’s performance drops from 63.32% (Event F1) to 51.46% on Event-Shot Association (EVSA F1), with open-source models failing to surpass 20%. Seed2.0 fails outright here, emitting almost no audio-event units (4.54% Event F1, 3.52% EVSA F1) despite top-ranked speaker attribution (91.80%). This suggests that models still largely process audio and visual streams as unaligned pathways rather than a unified structural graph.
blocks.zh: 第二,在音频和跨模式领域,我们的结构衡量标准显示出一种持续的模式脱节。 虽然模型在语音记录上表现优异(对话语义 ~ 80%\ geq 80\ ),但其对环境声音的听力推理仍然薄弱. 更为关键的是,真正的全方位理解要求将这些声音与并行的视觉源进行结构上的约束。 然而,双子座3.1-Pro的性能在事件-热会(EVSA F1)上从63.32%(Event F1)下降到了51.46%,开源模式未能超过20%. 种子2.0在这里完全失败,尽管排在前列的扬声器归属(91.80%),但几乎未发射音频活动单元(4.54%的事件F1,3.52%的EVSA F1)。 这表明模型仍然在很大程度上将音频和视觉流处理为不相通的路径,而不是统一的结构图.

blocks.en: Finally, by restricting semantic evaluation exclusively to structurally valid units, we isolate true descriptive fidelity from structural noise. This localized audit uncovers a stark precision-recall trade-off that holistic scoring masks behind fluent prose. For instance, Gemini 3.1-Pro adopts a conservative strategy (67.07% precision, 43.78% recall on subjects), omitting details to avoid errors, whereas other models inflate recall by hallucinating unverified attributes. MiniCPM-o-2.6 is the extreme case: it tops Scene precision (76.32%) while recalling only 20.39% of scene content. By enforcing strict structural prerequisites, OmniCapBench prevents models from gaming the evaluation, providing a clear roadmap for grounded omnimodal generation.
blocks.zh: 最后,通过将语义评价仅限于结构有效的单位,我们把真实的描述忠诚与结构噪声隔离开来. 这一地方性审计揭示了一种十分精确的回顾取舍,这种整体的得分口罩在流利的传言背后。 例如,双子座3.1-Pro采取了保守策略(精确度67.07%,对主体的回想率为43.78%),省略了细节来避免出错,而其他模型则通过幻觉未验证的属性来收起回想. MiniCPM-o-2.6是极端情况:它最多 场景精度(76.32%)虽然只召回了场景内容的20.39%. Omni Cap Bench通过执行严格的结构先决条件,阻止模型对评价进行游戏,为基于所有模式的生成提供了明确的路线图。

blocks.en: Error analysis. Figure 4(b) decomposes model failures into strict structural violations. We derive this composition by converting the performance on each rule-based structural metric into an absolute capability deficit ( 1 − score 1-\text{score} ) and normalizing these deficits to represent 100% of each model’s failure distribution. This detailed breakdown reveals insights invisible to holistic text metrics. First, format errors are negligible (1.3% for Gemini 3.1-Pro), indicating that schema adherence is a solved prerequisite. Second, we observe distinct failure signatures across model capabilities. For frontier models like Gemini 3.1-Pro, errors are highly concentrated in deep cross-modal links and fine-grained action details: action hallucination accounts for a massive 28.5% of its failures, followed by A-V misalignment (23.7%) and audio hallucination (17.9%). In contrast, open-source models suffer a systemic degradation, with errors distributed uniformly across both basic perception and complex audio-visual binding. This validates our core motivation: the true bottleneck in omnimodal video understanding lies not merely in describing isolated entities, but in avoiding deep-structured hallucinations like fabricating action details or assigning sounds to the wrong visual shot.
blocks.zh: 错误分析 。 图4(b)将模型故障分解为严格的结构违规. 我们通过将每个基于规则的结构度量的性能转化为绝对能力赤字(1–分1-\text{score}),并将这些赤字正常化,以代表每个模型的失败分布的100%来得出这种构成。 这一详细的细分揭示了整体文本衡量标准所看不到的洞察力。 首先,格式出错可以忽略不计(双子座3.1-Pro为1.3%),表明schema的坚持性是一个已解决的先决条件. 第二,我们观测到不同模型能力的明显故障签名。 对于双子座3.1-Pro等前沿模型,错误高度集中在深跨模式链接和精细的动作细节上:动作幻觉占其故障的28.5%,其次是A-V错配(23.7%)和音频幻觉(17.9%). 与此相反,开源模型系统退化,在基本感知和复杂的视听约束上,错误都统一分布。 这验证了我们的核心动机:全方位视频理解中的真正瓶颈不仅在于描述被孤立的实体,还在于避免像编造动作细节或给错误的视觉镜头分配声音这样的深层结构幻觉.

blocks.en: (a) The illusion of global scores. Text metrics reward fluent but flawed outputs; structured metrics expose them.
blocks.zh: (a) 国家 全球得分之幻想. 文本衡量标准奖励流利但有缺陷的产出;结构衡量标准暴露了这些产出。

blocks.en: (b) Failure composition. Distribution of structural errors, normalized by each model’s total failures.
blocks.zh: (b) 失败构成。 结构差错的分布,按每个模型的完全失败而正常化.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Evaluation paradigms and structural failures. (a) Global text metrics make distinct models appear similar, whereas structured constraints better match human audit. (b) Error composition shows different bottlenecks: frontier models concentrate failures in fine-grained hallucination and audio-visual alignment, while open-source models exhibit broader degradation.
blocks.zh: 图4:评价模式和结构失败。 (a) 全球文本衡量标准使不同的模型看起来相似,而结构化的制约则更符合人力审计。 (b) 错误构成显示不同的瓶颈:前沿模型将故障集中在精细的幻觉和视听对接上,而开源模型则显示出更广泛的退化。

blocks.en: 4.3 Auditing the Legacy Evaluation Paradigm
blocks.zh: 4.3 对遗产评价范式的审计

blocks.en: A fundamental motivation of OmniCapBench is that existing holistic evaluations conflate linguistic fluency with genuine multimodal comprehension. This section tests whether global text-centric evaluations provide a reliable diagnostic signal by auditing two core vulnerabilities: the tendency of monolithic scores to obscure localized structural errors, and the severe instability introduced by unconstrained LLM judges.
blocks.zh: Omni Cap Bench的一个基本动机是,现有的整体评价将语言流利与真正的多模式理解混为一谈。 本节通过审计两个核心弱点,检验全球以文字为中心的评价是否提供可靠的诊断信号:单曲分数掩盖局部结构错误的趋势,以及不受约束的LLM法官带来的严重不稳定。

blocks.en: Table 5: Judge sensitivity. Stability across judges.
blocks.zh: 表5:法官的敏感性。 法官之间的稳定。

blocks.en: Beyond masking errors, holistic evaluations introduce severe unreliability by forcing LLM judges to perform unconstrained global reasoning. To demonstrate this, we score identical model predictions using weak (Qwen3.6-27B), mid (GPT-4o), and strong (Gemini-2.5-Pro) judges across two baseline protocols: Holistic-style judging (UGC-VideoCap) and QA-style judging (Omni-Cloze). As Table 5 reports, both baselines exhibit extreme judge sensitivity—scores for the exact same outputs artificially inflate from 71.24 (weak judge) to 93.92 (strong judge). In contrast, OmniCapBench isolates the LLM’s role, restricting it exclusively to bounded semantic checks on structurally aligned units while leaving complex verification to deterministic rules. By eliminating implicit fact extraction and unconstrained reasoning, OmniCapBench establishes a stable, objective scoring framework resilient to judge idiosyncrasies.
blocks.zh: 除了掩盖错误外,整体评价还迫使LLM法官进行不受约束的全球推理,从而造成严重的不可靠性。 为了证明这一点,我们用弱(Qune3.6-27B)、中(GPT-4o)和强(Gemini-2.5-Pro)的评委通过两个基线协议获得相同的模型预测:全能式判断(UGC-Video Cap)和QA式判断(Omni-Cloze)。 如表5所报告,两个基线都显示出极具判断力的敏感性——对完全相同的产出的分数人为地从71.24(弱法官)增加到93.92(强法官)。 相比之下,Omni Cap Bench将LLM的作用隔离开来,将LLM完全限制在对结构对齐的单位进行有界限的语义检查,同时将复杂的核查留给决定规则. Omni Cap Bench通过消除隐含的事实取出和不受约束的推理,建立了一个稳定客观的得分框架来适应判断特异性.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Qualitative case study of deep-structured diagnostics. Traditional holistic evaluations often over-reward fluent prose, missing critical errors like hallucinated “protective eyewear” or temporally unsupported actions. By performing bounded semantic checks on structurally valid units and assigning localized Recall and Precision, OmniCapBench decouples genuine descriptive fidelity from structural noise, providing a high-resolution diagnostic trace.
blocks.zh: 图5:深层结构诊断定性案例研究. 传统的整体评价往往报酬过高,传言流利,遗漏了诸如幻觉中的“保护眼衣”或暂时得不到支持的行动等重大错误。 Omni Cap Bench通过对结构有效的单位进行有限度的语义检查,并分配局部的回召和精准度,使真实的描述忠诚与结构噪声脱钩,提供高分辨率的诊断跟踪。

blocks.en: To empirically investigate whether compressing omnimodal events into a global scalar masks capability deficits, we construct hard-to-distinguish subsets of 200 videos from the UGC-VideoCap and video-SALMONN 2 benchmarks. Specifically, we define two evaluation pairs representing model upgrades: Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash vs. Qwen3-Omni, and Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus vs. Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash (details in Appendix B.2 ). For each pair, we strictly sample videos where the weaker and stronger models exhibit near-identical performance ( ∼ \sim 50% vs. ∼ \sim 50%) under traditional text-centric metrics, creating a false illusion of parity. However, as Table B.7 and Figure 4(a) demonstrate, shifting the evaluation to native structural constraints completely breaks this illusion. The average score of the stronger models climbs to perfectly align with human audit (74.2%), whereas the weaker models collapse (25.8%) when their structural flaws are exposed. This confirms our core hypothesis: global metrics are easily manipulated by linguistic fluency, inadvertently rewarding structurally flawed outputs as long as the generated prose is coherent. Relying on a monolithic text presentation layer severely degrades diagnostic resolution, necessitating a shift towards deep-structured evaluation.
blocks.zh: 为了实证地调查是否将自制式事件压缩成全球平面罩能力缺陷,我们从UGC-VideoCap和Video-SALMONN 2基准中构建出200个难以分辨的子集. 具体地说,我们定义了代表模型升级的两种评价对: 克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克 对于每对,我们严格地对视频进行抽样,其中弱和强的模型在传统的以文字为中心的度量标准下表现出近同性能(\\\sim 50% vs. \sim 50%),从而产生虚假的对等假象. 然而,如表B.7和图4(a)所显示的,将评价转向本土结构限制,完全打破了这种幻想。 较强模型的平均得分攀升到与人的审计完全一致(74.2%),而较弱模型在暴露其结构缺陷时会倒闭(25.8%). 这证实了我们的核心假设:全球指标很容易被语言流利所操纵,无意中奖励结构上有缺陷的产出,只要产生的传言是连贯的。 依靠单一的文本演示层严重地降低诊断分辨率,因此有必要转向结构深厚的评价。

blocks.en: We qualitatively validate this decoupled scoring approach in Figure 5 . Traditional paradigms are easily confounded by fluent hallucinations; for instance, unconstrained metrics frequently reward Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus for hallucinating detailed but unsupported attributes (e.g., “protective eyewear”) because the overall prose reads well. Furthermore, models often generate plausible action descriptions that completely violate the continuous temporal boundaries of the visual shot. By strictly decomposing the evaluation into atomic units and enforcing structural alignment before any semantic checking, OmniCapBench explicitly penalizes these specific omissions and temporal violations through localized Recall and Precision scores. This traceable diagnostic process guarantees that the final score reflects precise spatial-temporal grounding rather than mere text-generation capability.
blocks.zh: 我们在图5中从质量上验证了这种脱钩的评分方法。 传统范式很容易被流畅的幻觉所迷惑;例如,不受约束的度量衡经常奖励Quen3.5-Omni-Plus产生幻觉的详尽而无凭据的属性(如"保护眼衣"),因为总的道具读得很好. 此外,模型往往产生可信的动作描述,完全违反了视觉镜头的连续时间界限. Omni Cap Bench严格地将评价分解为原子单位,并在任何语义检查前强制进行结构调整,从而通过局部召回和精度分数来明确惩罚这些具体的遗漏和时间违规。 这种可追踪的诊断过程保证了最终得分反映精确的空间-时空地平,而不仅仅是文本生成能力.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: The reliable evaluation of audio–visual captioning must provide fine-grained, localizable diagnostic signals. To address this need, we propose OmniCapBench, which reframes the evaluation process through deep-structured evaluation units. The resulting atomic units across Reference, Shot, and Event tracks ensure that the evaluation achieves comprehensive video coverage while preserving fine-grained detail. Moreover, this atomic formulation enables a decoupled scoring process, in which deterministic rules rigorously verify structural relationships and LLMs are strictly restricted to local semantic checks. Beyond establishing a rigorous benchmark for current multimodal models, our empirical analysis reveals critical flaws in holistic paradigms. Global text scores often mask localized errors and reward structurally inconsistent outputs, while unconstrained LLM judges introduce severe ranking instability. Ultimately, OmniCapBench demonstrates that reliable evaluation requires moving from monolithic text generation to verifiable atomic units, transforming performance measurement into an actionable diagnostic tool for multimodal systems.
blocks.zh: 对视听字幕的可靠评价必须提供精细、可本地化的诊断信号。 为满足这一需要,我们提议Omni Cap Bench,通过结构严密的评价单位重新界定评价过程。 由此产生的原子单位跨越参考、射击和事件轨道,确保评价实现全面的视频报道,同时保留精细的细节。 此外,这种原子配方使评分过程脱钩,其中确定性规则严格核查结构关系,有限责任公司严格限于当地语义检查。 除了为目前的多式联运模式制定严格的基准外,我们的经验分析还揭示出整体模式中的重大缺陷。 全球文本分数往往会掩盖本地化错误并奖励结构上不一致的产出,而不受约束的LLM评委则引入了严重的排名不稳定. 归根结底,OmniCap Bench表明,可靠的评价需要从单体文本生成转向可核查的原子单位,将性能测量转化为多模式系统的可操作诊断工具。

blocks.en: This appendix provides comprehensive supplementary materials to ensure the reproducibility and transparency of the OmniCapBench benchmark. The appendix is structured as follows:

blocks.en: • Implementation Details (Appendix A ): Details the benchmark construction process, data statistics, and the full experimental setup used for evaluation. • More Experimental Results (Appendix B ): Provides additional quantitative results, detailed failure analyses, and qualitative Case Studies. • Limitations and Broader Impact (Appendix C ): Discusses the boundaries of our evaluation scope and the broader impacts of structured video benchmarking. • Ethical Considerations (Appendix D ): Addresses privacy, consent, and the ethical use of audio-visual datasets. • Dataset Licenses and Usage (Appendix E ): Documents the licenses and fair-use protocols for all underlying video sources and utilized models. • Instruction Templates and Prompts (Appendix F ): Provides the complete, executable prompts used for unit generation, local semantic judging, and structural parsing.

blocks.en: Our construction pipeline combines data curation with a multi-model pipeline. Figure 2 illustrates this workflow.

blocks.en: 1. Candidate Curation Thresholds: Before semantic annotation begins, candidate videos are filtered by technical quality, audio availability, and predefined duration buckets ( < 1 <1 min, 1 1 – 3 3 min, 3 3 – 5 5 min). We additionally enforce minimum structural density thresholds, such as minimum shots, events, and characters per minute, so that selected videos contain enough audio-visual structure for deep-structured evaluation. The exact thresholds are detailed in Table A.2 .
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 候选人描述 阈值 : 在语义注释开始之前,候选视频通过技术质量,音频可用性,以及预定义的时长桶来过滤( < 1 < 1分,1–3分,3–5分). 我们进一步实施最低结构密度阈值,例如最低镜头、事件和每分钟的字符,以便选定的视频包含足够的视听结构,用于深层结构的评价。 确切阈值详见表A.2。

blocks.en: 2. Multi-Model Pipeline: We decompose the annotation into a multi-role pipeline: • Generator: Initially drafts candidate JSON for the current track, for instance, all Reference entities. • Format Verification: A deterministic script verifies required keys, ID uniqueness, temporal bounds, cross-links, and support fields. Malformed drafts are immediately rejected and returned with structured error traces for regeneration. • Evaluators: Independent frontier models review the drafted facts for factual accuracy, temporal consistency, and structural coherence against the raw video. • Refiners: Accepted drafts are passed to secondary models to locally refine and enrich descriptive fields, for instance, expanding the visual details of an appearance_anchor . Crucially, this refinement occurs under the strict condition that the established structure remains invariant; a programmatic validator ensures all IDs, timestamps, and cross-links are unmodified. If a textual refinement breaks a structural link, the pipeline falls back to the original verified draft. • Selector: Acts as the final judge, selecting the most accurate verified version without permission to rewrite any fields. This separation of roles maintains structural consistency. Candidate states remain mere “drafts” until they pass all Format Verifications and consensus checks, culminating in human review.
blocks.zh: 2. 多模式 管道 : 我们把注释分解成一个多作用管道: 发电机:最初为当前轨道起草候选人JSON,例如所有参考实体。 • 格式核查: 确定性脚本验证所需的密钥,ID独有性,时间界限,交叉链接,以及支持字段. 错误的草稿立即被否决,并带着结构化的错误痕迹返回,以供再生. 二. 支助 评估者:独立前沿模型对所起草的事实进行审查,以确定事实准确性、时间一致性和结构与原始视频的一致性。 二. 支助 炼油厂:接受的草案被转给二级模型,以便在当地精炼和丰富描述领域,例如扩大外观细节。 关键的是,这种改进是在既定结构仍然变化无常的严格条件下进行的;一个程序验证器确保所有ID,时间戳和交叉连接都是没有被修改的. 如果文字上的修饰打破了结构链接,管道就会倒回原已核实的草稿. • 选择者:担任最后的法官,在未经许可的情况下选择最准确的经核实的版本来改写任何字段。 这种角色的分化保持了结构上的一致性. 候选国在通过所有格式核查和协商一致核查之前,仍然只是“草案”,最终进行人文审查。

blocks.en: To evaluate models natively, we instruct them to generate outputs strictly conforming to the OmniCapBench JSON schema. This schema explicitly defines the references , events , and shots domains, alongside their mandatory structural links and support fields. Table A.3 summarizes these required components. If a model fails to adhere to these structural instructions, such as outputting a continuous paragraph instead of a parseable JSON graph, it triggers a parse failure at the SGC gate and receives a score of 0 for all downstream metrics.
blocks.zh: 为了对模型进行本土评估,我们指示它们产生完全符合OmniCap Bench JSON计划的产出。 这一计划明确定义了参考、事件和镜头域,以及其强制性的结构链接和支持域。 表A.3汇总了这些所需组成部分。 如果一个模型未能遵守这些结构指令,例如输出出一个连续段落而不是一个可解析的JSON图,则会触发SGC门的解析失败并获得所有下游度量的分数为0.

blocks.en: During inference, all generative models operate at a temperature of 0.0 (greedy decoding) to minimize structural hallucinations, with a maximum output limit of 4096 tokens. The detailed instruction templates used in our pipeline are provided at the end of this appendix.
blocks.zh: 在推论期间,所有基因模型的运行温度为0.0(greedy decoding)来将结构幻觉最小化,最大输出极限为4096个令牌. 本附录末尾提供了我们管道中使用的详细指导模板。

blocks.en: A.1.3 Generation and Evaluation Protocols
blocks.zh: A.1.3 生成和评价议定书

blocks.en: This section details the implementation mechanics of OmniCapBench, including how models are invoked for structured generation and how LLM-assisted matching and judging are executed in code.
blocks.zh: 本节详述了Omni Cap Bench的执行力学,包括如何为结构化生成而引用模型,以及LLM辅助匹配和判断是如何在代码中执行的.

blocks.en: Because OmniCapBench strictly requires the generation of complex, interdependent JSON schemas, interacting with diverse model APIs requires robust programmatic handling. As implemented in our evaluation engine: • Modality Inputs: Proprietary models, such as the Gemini family, receive the video via native API upload endpoints or HTTP URLs, while open-source checkpoints, including the Qwen-Omni series, receive interleaved Base64-encoded visual frames and raw audio waveforms alongside the task instruction. • Retry and Repair Logic: The pipeline automatically strips hallucinated markdown formatting, for instance, ‘‘‘json ... ‘‘‘ delimiters. If the output remains structurally malformed, the system triggers up to 5 exponential-backoff retries. If the model consistently fails to produce a valid JSON schema, the output is permanently logged as a parse failure, and all downstream structural metrics for that sample evaluate to zero.
blocks.zh: 因为"Omni Cap Bench"严格要求生成复杂,相互依存的JSON schemas,与多种模型API的相互作用需要强大的程序处理. 正如我们的评价引擎所实施的那样: • Modality Introductions:自有型号,如双子座家族,通过本地API上传端点或HTTP URL接收视频,而开源检查站,包括Quen-Omni系列,则在任务指令的同时接收互放的Base64编码可视帧和原始音频波形. • 重试和修理逻辑: 管道会自动剥去幻觉的标记下格式,例如:QQjson...XQ分界线. 如果输出在结构上仍然有缺陷,系统会触发多达5个指数后退回击. 如果该模型一直未能产生有效的JSON schema,则该输出被永久记录为剖析失败,该样本的所有下游结构度量计均被评为零.

blocks.en: To generate the required atomic units, models are guided by a comprehensive schema definition. Depending on the model’s context window and reasoning capacity, the inference engine employs one of two strategies: • Single-Pass Generation: The model receives the full video alongside a unified system instruction and is required to output a single, complete JSON object containing the references , events , and shots arrays. This approach tests the model’s ability to globally reason over the entire narrative. • Progressive Pipeline: For extremely long videos or models with limited context windows, generation is decoupled. First, the model processes the entire video to extract persistent entities. Then, it processes the video in sliding temporal segments to generate temporally grounded events and shots , actively referencing the global entities defined in the first step.
blocks.zh: 为了产生所需的原子单位,模型以一个全面的计划定义为指导. 根据模型的上下文窗口和推理能力,推论引擎采用了两种策略之一: • 单相扇生成: 该模型与一个统一的系统指令一起接收完整的视频,并且需要输出一个包含参考文献,事件和镜头阵列的完整JSON对象. 这种方法在整个叙述中检验模型的全球理性能力。 • 渐进管道: 对于内容窗口有限的极长的视频或模型,生成被解开. 首先,模型处理整个视频以提取持久性实体. 然后,它用滑动时间段处理视频,生成基于时间的事件和镜头,并积极参考第一步所定义的全球实体。

blocks.en: The generation instructions serve as the strict standard operating procedure for the models. Rather than allowing the model to freely interpret the task, we embed explicit annotation guidelines directly into the system instruction. To ensure models accurately ground their predictions, the protocol enforces several critical principles:
blocks.zh: 生成指令是这些模型的严格标准操作程序. 我们不容许模型自由解释任务,而是将明确的注释准则直接纳入系统指令。 为确保模型准确预测结果,协议执行了若干关键原则:

blocks.en: • Timestamp Convention: Models must report every temporal field as a [start, end] range in seconds relative to the beginning of the video, and are instructed to keep all boundaries inside the video duration; out-of-range predictions are clamped before scoring (Appendix A.2.5 ). Evaluated models receive the original, unaltered frames: no timestamp is burned into the pixels and no per-frame time index is injected into the prompt, so every temporal boundary must be inferred from the video stream itself (Listing B.1). The red timestamp overlays used during reference construction (Appendix A.1.1 ) are an annotation aid only and never appear in any model-facing input. • Mute Video Handling: If a video contains no audio track, the model is strictly forbidden from inferring auditory events based on visual cues; for instance, a person moving their mouth must not trigger a hallucinated dialogue event unless audio is actually present. • Minimum Granularity Principle (Visual Subshots): Models are instructed to decompose visual narratives into the smallest indivisible atomic actions. For instance, rather than generating a compound description like “picked up the cup, drank, and put it down,” the model is forced to split this into three distinct subshots. • Temporal Overlap Principle: Crucially, models are explicitly encouraged to generate overlapping temporal boundaries for subshots. If Person A is walking while Person B is nodding, these are treated as concurrent independent streams rather than being artificially serialized. • Strict Objectivity: Models must describe pure visual and auditory facts. We explicitly ban causal connective inferences, for instance, “The vase broke because the ball hit it.” , in favor of sequential factual statements.
blocks.zh: • 《时间戳公约》: 模型必须把每个时间域作为相对于视频开头的[起始,结束]范围以秒来报告,并被指示将所有边界都保留在视频持续时间之内;外程预测被夹在分数之前(附录A.2.5.). 被评价的模型接收了原始的,没有改变的帧:没有时间戳被烧入像素中,也没有将每个帧的时间指数注入到快取中,因此每个时间界限都必须从视频流本身推断出(Listing B. 参考构建中使用的红色时间戳(Appendix A.1.1.)只是一种注释性帮助,从未出现在任何模型化输入中. 二. 支助 静音视频 处理 : 如果视频中没有音频音轨,则严格禁止该模型根据视觉提示推断出听觉事件;例如,移动口号的人不得触发幻觉对话事件,除非音频实际存在. • 最小颗粒度原则(视觉分弹): 模型被指示将视觉叙述分解为最小的不可分割原子行动. 例如,该模型没有制作“取出杯子、喝下并放倒”的复合描述,而是被迫将它分成三个不同的分集。 • 时间重叠原则: 关键是,明确鼓励模型产生分弹的重叠时间界限. 如果A个人在行走而B个人在点头,这些被作为同时存在的独立溪流处理,而不是人为地串行. • 严格客观性:模型必须描述纯粹的视觉和听觉事实。 我们明确禁止因果关联推论,例如“花瓶被球击中而破裂”。

blocks.en: OmniCapBench evaluates models across diverse content domains and temporal scales. We report detailed dataset statistics not to claim unrestricted universal coverage, but to explicitly define the boundaries of our evaluation scope. As detailed in Table A.4 , the benchmark comprises 786 videos with verified structural averages. We break down this diversity across multiple structural and semantic dimensions to ensure our testbed evaluates joint audio-visual comprehension robustly.
blocks.zh: OmniCap Bench评价不同内容领域和时间尺度的模型。 我们报告详细的数据集统计数据,不是为了声称无限制的普及,而是为了明确界定我们评价范围的界限。 如表A.4所详述,该基准包括786个录像,经核实的结构平均值。 我们从多个结构和语义层面分解出这种多样性,以确保我们的试验台能够有力地评价视听共同理解。

blocks.en: To ensure the highest possible data quality for OmniCapBench, we implement a rigorous, iterative human annotation and refinement protocol. Rather than simply calculating post-hoc agreement scores, our pipeline is designed around continuous error discovery and correction. This multi-stage quality assurance process guarantees that the final benchmark data is structurally flawless, semantically rich, and strictly faithful to the original video evidence.
blocks.zh: 为了确保Omni Cap Bench尽可能高的数据质量,我们实施了严格的、迭代的人类注释和完善协议。 我们的管道不是简单的计算 事后协议的分数, 而是围绕着 持续的错误发现 和纠正。 这种多阶段的质量保证过程保证了最终基准数据在结构上没有缺陷,精密丰富,严格忠实于原始视频证据.

blocks.en: Professional Annotator Training. We engaged a team of professional annotators with extensive experience in dense video captioning and complex multi-modal data processing. Prior to the formal annotation phase, all annotators underwent comprehensive training on the OmniCapBench JSON schema and standardized corner cases. This training specifically addressed challenging scenarios such as heavily occluded characters, ambiguous shot boundaries, overlapping audio events, and fine-grained visual state transitions.
blocks.zh: 专业注释员培训. 我们聘请了一批专业的注释员,他们具有密集视频字幕和复杂多式数据处理方面的广泛经验。 在正式说明阶段之前,所有注释员都接受了关于OmniCap Bench JSON计划案和标准化转角案的全面培训。 这一培训特别针对一些具有挑战性的情景,如被严重占领的人物、模糊的镜头界限、相重叠的音频事件以及精细的视觉状态过渡。

blocks.en: Iterative Refinement Pipeline. The core of our high-quality data generation is an iterative “review-and-refine” mechanism. Initial drafts, whether generated by annotators or derived from the multi-model pipeline, are subjected to meticulous human review using a synchronized video-audio playback interface. Reviewers scrutinize the drafts for: • Structural Integrity: Ensuring that all ID references ( ref_id , event_id ) are consistently maintained across temporal boundaries without hallucinated links. • Temporal Precision: Fine-tuning the start and end timestamps for visual shots and audio events down to the frame level. • Semantic Granularity: Expanding overly generic descriptions into highly specific factual statements, for instance, adding exact clothing details, specific character poses, or nuanced environmental audio cues.
blocks.zh: 迭代精炼管. 我们高质量数据生成的核心是迭接式的“审查和完善”机制。 最初的草稿,无论是由注释者生成的,还是由多型管所衍生出,都使用同步的视频-音频回放接口进行仔细的人文审查. 审查者仔细审查草稿的如下内容: • 结构完整性:确保所有ID参考文献( ref_id, event_id)在时间界限上一致保持,没有幻觉链接. • 时间精度: 精细调整视觉镜头和音频事件的始末时间戳下至帧平. • 语义外观: 将过于笼统的描述扩展为非常具体的事实陈述,例如,增加准确的服装细节、具体特征或细微的环境音频提示。

blocks.zh: 结构完整性:确保所有ID参考文献( ref_id, event_id)在时间界限上一致保持,没有幻觉链接.

blocks.en: Temporal Precision: Fine-tuning the start and end timestamps for visual shots and audio events down to the frame level.
blocks.zh: 时间精度 : 精细调整视觉镜头和音频事件的始末时间戳下至帧平.

blocks.zh: 语义外观: 将过于笼统的描述扩展为非常具体的事实陈述,例如,增加准确的服装细节、具体特征或细微的环境音频提示。

blocks.en: Whenever an error, omission, or ambiguity is identified, the annotation is sent back for immediate refinement. This targeted correction loop is repeated until the JSON output perfectly reflects the video’s ground truth.
blocks.zh: 凡发现出错、遗漏或模糊之处时,便将注释发回,以便立即加以改进。 JSON的输出完全反映影片的地面真相。

blocks.en: Multi-Stage Adjudication. To resolve complex edge cases, we employ a multi-stage adjudication process. If annotators disagree on the interpretation of a scene, for example, determining whether a background noise constitutes a distinct event or how to segment a continuous camera movement, the case is escalated to senior reviewers. These domain experts finalize the annotations based strictly on the raw video and audio evidence. This protocol ensures that our evaluation references are not only format-compliant but set a gold standard for comprehensive, verifiable audio-visual understanding.
blocks.zh: 多斯达磨. 为了解决复杂的边缘案件,我们采用了一个多阶段的裁决程序。 如果注释者对某一场景的解释有分歧,例如,确定背景噪声是否构成一个不同的事件,或者如何分割连续相机运动,则案件升级为高级审查员. 这些领域专家严格根据原始视频和音频证据最后敲定说明。 这项议定书确保我们的评价参考资料不仅符合格式,而且为全面、可核查的视听理解确立了金标准。

blocks.en: Before scoring, predicted units must be structurally aligned to ground-truth units (as formalized in Appendix A.2.5 ). The programmatic matching principles are implemented as follows: • Reference Matching: Performed via an LLM-assisted bipartite matcher. The matcher is restricted to comparing only the appearance_anchor.id_features.detail_description of the entities. It strictly enforces a one-to-one match based on semantic equivalence, rejecting generic overlaps, empty descriptions, or contradictory identity/clothing facts. • Event Matching: Handled deterministically. Dialogue events are matched using normalized Word Error Rate (WER) against the transcribed text (threshold ≥ 0.50 \geq 0.50 ). Non-dialogue events, including sound effects and background music, are matched purely based on their temporal Intersection-over-Union (tIoU) (threshold ≥ 0.20 \geq 0.20 ). • Shot and Subshot Matching: Visual shots are matched one-to-one via temporal IoU (threshold ≥ 0.30 \geq 0.30 ). Subshots are then matched locally within their aligned parent shots using an expanded time window ( δ = 1.0 ​ s \delta=1.0\text{s} ).

blocks.en: This appendix formally defines the OmniCapBench evaluation suite. Our core evaluation philosophy shifts video benchmarking from weak, holistic definitions (where an entire paragraph is judged opaquely) to strong, structural definitions . We define individual information points, including characters, sound events, and visual actions, as verifiable atomic units , whose interactions are strictly verified by deterministic rules before localized LLM scoring.
blocks.zh: 本附录正式定义了OmniCap Bench评价套件. 我们的核心评价理念将视频基准从弱而全面的定义(整个段落被不透明地判断)转变为强有力的结构定义。 我们把个人的信息点,包括人物,声音事件,和视觉动作,定义为可核查的原子单位,它们的相互作用在本地化LLM分数前通过定型规则严格核实.

blocks.en: Why bidirectional evaluation is necessary. Unlike multiple-choice or short-answer tasks, audio-visual captioning is fundamentally open-ended: there is no single “correct” output string. When humans and models caption the exact same video, their structured representations rarely form a perfect one-to-one mapping. Three recurring sources of mismatch motivate our design:
blocks.zh: 为什么必须进行双向评价。 与多选择或短答任务不同,视听字幕基本上是开放式的:没有单一的"正确"输出字符串. 当人类和模型对完全相同的视频进行字幕时,其结构化的表示很少形成完美的一对一映射. 三个反复出现的不匹配因素激励着我们的设计:

blocks.en: • Granularity mismatch: A model might decompose a continuous 5-second visual action into three dense, fine-grained subshots, whereas the ground truth summarizes the same sequence into a single cohesive subshot. Both decompositions can be factually correct. • Attribute selection divergence: A model might describe a character by clothing and posture, while the human annotator emphasizes hairstyle and facial features; both descriptions are valid, yet they share few lexical tokens. • Structural topology variation: Models may group audio events under different shots than humans, or split a single reference entity into multiple aliases, creating non-trivial alignment challenges even when the underlying facts are equivalent.
blocks.zh: • 外观不匹配: 一个模型可能会将连续5秒的视觉动作分解为3个密集而精细的子镜头,而地真将相同的序列总结成一个相接的子镜头. 两种分解均可在事实上正确. 二. 支助 属性选择差异 : 一个模型可能用衣着和姿势来描述一个人物,而人类的注释者则强调发型和面部特征;两种描述都是有效的,然而它们分享的词典符号很少. • 结构地貌变化: 模型可能会将音频事件分到与人类不同的镜头下,或者将一个单一的参考实体分拆成多个别名,即使基本事实等同,也会产生非三角对接的挑战.

blocks.en: The problem with unidirectional evaluation. Because of these mismatches, evaluating open-ended captioning from a single direction is intrinsically biased and gameable:
blocks.zh: 单向评价的问题。 由于这些不匹配,从一个方向评价开放式字幕本质上是偏颇和可玩性:

blocks.en: • Recall-only evaluation (checking whether the prediction covers the ground truth) rewards excessively verbose, speculative outputs that guarantee coverage at the cost of significant hallucinations. • Precision-only evaluation (checking whether the ground truth supports the prediction) rewards overly terse, generic responses that are trivially correct but miss key video details.
blocks.zh: • 仅召回评价(检查预测是否涵盖地面真相)对过度动词、投机性产出产生好处,保证以重大幻觉为代价进行覆盖。 · 仅进行精确评价(检查地面真相是否支持预测),奖励过于夸张,一般反应略为正确,但错过了关键视频细节。

blocks.en: Our solution: bidirectional matching and scoring. To address this, OmniCapBench applies a bidirectional matching and scoring paradigm specifically for open-vocabulary and continuous fields where the above mismatches are most pronounced, namely References (Subject and Scene appearances) and visual Subshots. We evaluate these elements from two complementary perspectives, both during the structural matching phase (determining which predicted units correspond to which ground-truth units) and the subsequent local semantic scoring phase (measuring how well a matched pair agrees on factual content).
blocks.zh: 我们的解决方案是双向匹配和分数 为了解决这个问题,Omni Cap Bench采用了双向匹配和打分的范式,专门针对上述不匹配现象最突出的开放-vocabulary和连续字段,即参考文献(Subject and Scene expects)和视觉子shot. 我们从两个互补的角度来评估这些要素,无论是在结构匹配阶段(确定哪些预测单位对应哪些地面真实单位),还是在随后的当地语义评分阶段(衡量匹配的对子在事实内容上是否一致)。

blocks.en: Tie-Breaking Rules: For rule-based event and shot matching, candidate pairs are sorted by their matching score and consumed one-to-one. In instances where multiple predicted units achieve the exact same score against a ground-truth unit, we prioritize the prediction with the earlier temporal start time ( t s t_{s} ). If a tie persists, we break it using the lexical order of the predicted ID string. Reference matching is parsed from the LLM-produced bipartite map and then defensively checked for valid IDs, type compatibility, and one-to-one consistency.
blocks.zh: 铁打规则: 对于以规则为基础的事件和射击相配,候选配对按其相配分排序并消耗一对一. 在多个预测单位对地真单位取得完全相同的分数的情况下,我们以更早的时间开始时间(t s t_{s})优先预测。 如果一个平局持续,我们用预测的ID字符串的词典顺序打破它. 引用匹配从LLM出品的双相相图中解析出,然后防御性地检查有效的ID,类型相容性,以及一对一的一致性.

blocks.en: To ensure fair and transparent comparisons, this section explicitly documents the technical parameters used to evaluate each model. In total, we assessed 12 distinct models. To clarify the division between the main results and the robustness analysis: • Main Benchmark Table: Evaluates 7 native-capable omnimodal models (three proprietary models via API and four open-source checkpoints). These models are capable of processing unstructured audio-visual streams and following instructions to generate structured outputs. • Appendix Robustness Table (Appendix B.5 ): Evaluates 5 specialized video-captioning baselines . These models do not enter the main ranking because their SFT heavily degrades structured schema-following. We explicitly report these failures and their performance via the caption-posthoc route to demonstrate why free-form prose cannot substitute for native atomic unit prediction.

It defines exactly what constitutes a failure under each metric family, ensuring every error is interpretable as a concrete, broken structural link rather than a subjective LLM penalty.

blocks.en: How to read the diagnostic categories. • Schema or canonicalization failure (Gate): The model completely failed instruction following. The output cannot be converted into the scored unit system, rendering downstream semantic checks mathematically impossible. • Visual reasoning failures (Visual): The model misses persistent entities, hallucinates non-existent objects, uses the wrong mapped ID when referring to an object in a scene, fails to maintain the same identity for a character across disconnected scenes, or misaligns visual boundaries. • Audio reasoning failures (Audio): Essential audio events are entirely missing, hallucinated, or aligned to the wrong time segment in the audio track. • Cross-modal and dialogue failures (Audio-Visual): An event may be plausible in isolation but is attached to the wrong visual region (demonstrating a failure in cross-modal structural reasoning), or spoken dialogue is mis-transcribed or assigned to the wrong speaker. These structured categories explain precisely why a fluent, holistic caption can appear superficially correct globally while failing rigorously on localized evaluations.

blocks.en: As revealed in Table A.9 , evaluating models purely via dense text generation obscures severe structural failures. The highest failure rates occur in Identity Persistence (65.2%) and Temporal Alignment (42.0%). These numbers prove that while models can fluently generate nouns and verbs (yielding high text-level scores), they fundamentally struggle to maintain object permanence across shots or anchor events to precise timeline segments. Relying solely on holistic LLM judging masks these precise failure modes, confirming our motivation that reliable evaluation inherently requires structured, atomic verification.
blocks.zh: 如表A.9所示,纯粹通过密集的文本生成来评价模型掩盖了严重的结构故障。 失败率最高的是身份持久性(65.2%)和临时调整(42.0%)。 这些数字证明,虽然模型可以流利地生成名词和动词(使高文本分数产生高文本分数),但是它们根本上却挣扎着在镜头或锚定事件之间保持物体的持久性,直到精确的时间段. 完全依靠整体的LLM来判断这些精确的失败模式,证实我们的动机是可靠的评价本身需要结构化的原子核查。

blocks.en: A.2.4 Consistency Checks
blocks.zh: A.2.4 一致性检查

blocks.en: As introduced in Task 2 (Section 3.2 ), Structural Consistency Probes are the deterministic rules for auditing the structural relationships of a model’s prediction before invoking any LLM-as-judge. To transition these from abstract evaluation concepts into an executable test suite, we formalize them as logical predicates. These probes automatically verify whether the predicted units utilize valid reference IDs, possess logically compatible time ranges, and maintain consistent cross-modal links.
blocks.zh: 正如任务2(第3.2节)所介绍的,结构一致性试验是先对模型预测的结构关系进行审计的决定性规则,然后再援引任何LLM即时判断。 为了把这些从抽象的评价概念转换成可执行的测试套件,我们将它们正式化为逻辑的上游. 这些探测器自动核查预测单位是否使用有效的参考ID,是否具有逻辑相容的时间范围,并保持一致的跨模式链接.

blocks.en: We define the following formal predicates, each tied to an exact, programmatic failure trigger: • ValidRefUse ⁡ ( x , r ) \mathrm{ValidRefUse}(x,r) : For any event or shot x x , if x x claims to feature reference r r , then r r must exist in the top-level references list. Failure trigger : A dangling ID is utilized. • ValidEventShotAssociation ⁡ ( e , h ) \mathrm{ValidEventShotAssociation}(e,h) : If event e e is linked to shot h h , they must exhibit a strictly positive temporal overlap ( IoU ⁡ ( t ​ i ​ m ​ e ​ ( e ) , t ​ i ​ m ​ e ​ ( h ) ) > 0 \mathrm{IoU}(time(e),time(h))>0 ). Failure trigger : An event is linked to a completely disjoint visual shot. • TemporalCompatible ⁡ ( e , h ) \mathrm{TemporalCompatible}(e,h) : The duration of sub-elements, including subshots or active events, must be bounded by, or reasonably overlap with, their parent shot’s duration. Failure trigger : A subshot’s timestamp significantly exceeds the boundaries of its parent shot. • ConsistentCoreference ⁡ ( r ​ across ​ ℋ ) \mathrm{ConsistentCoreference}(r\text{ across }\mathcal{H}) : An ID mapped to a persistent entity must map consistently across the video’s timeline without splitting into hallucinated variants. Failure trigger : A tracked character abruptly changes ID assignment across sequential cuts. • SupportFieldPresent ⁡ ( r ) \mathrm{SupportFieldPresent}(r) : Every reference r r must possess its required evidence fields, most notably, the appearance_anchor . Failure trigger : The prediction omits the appearance_anchor dictionary entirely. • NoDanglingID ⁡ ( 𝒮 ^ ) \mathrm{NoDanglingID}(\hat{\mathcal{S}}) : No unreferenced or circular links exist in the final prediction graph. Failure trigger : A shot claims it contains an event ID that was never defined.

The high failure rates in Cross-reference integrity (65.2%) and Temporal compatibility (42.0%) highlight that the true bottleneck for current omnimodal architectures is not isolated frame perception, but rather building a coherent spatiotemporal graph. Models often hallucinate entity IDs or assign disjoint time boundaries even when the basic visual components are correctly detected. blocks.en: A.2.5 Alignment Protocol
blocks.zh: A.2.5 协调议定书

blocks.en: Before calculating any structural metrics, we canonicalize raw model outputs into a standardized evaluation graph and then align prediction units to the ground-truth units. This pipeline explicitly tracks and preserves the structural intent behind raw JSON outputs. Canonicalization, temporal matching, and rule checks are rule-based; reference alignment is a bounded LLM-assisted one-to-one matching step over reference detail descriptions. All thresholds and tie-breaking rules for rule-based matching are fixed prior to computing model scores.
blocks.zh: 在计算任何结构度量标准之前,我们把原始模型输出量分类成一个标准化的评价图,然后将预测单位与地面真实单位相匹配。 这一管道明确跟踪并保持了JSON原始产出背后的结构意图。 条码化,时间匹配,和规则检查都是以规则为基础的;引用对接是一个被绑定的LLM辅助一对一匹配步骤,而不是引用细节描述. 基于规则的比对的所有阈值和打结规则在计算模型分数之前都是固定的.

blocks.en: Cross-Track Linking Instruction (Excerpt) The most important step: Use the ‘active_events‘ array to accurately link the current visual shot with the audio events happening simultaneously. - Every ‘event_id‘ listed in a shot’s ‘active_events‘ array MUST come from the previously defined ‘events‘ list. - Fill this accurately based on temporal overlap: if any part of an event’s ‘time_range‘ overlaps with the current shot’s ‘time_range‘, that ‘event_id‘ MUST be included in ‘active_events‘. - CROSS-VALIDATION: Check that the union of ‘active_events‘ across all shots covers every single ‘event_id‘ defined in the video. Do not leave any event dangling.

blocks.en: Appendix B More Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 附录B 更多实验结果

blocks.en: B.1 Intra-Family Metric Correlation
blocks.zh: B.1 家庭内部计量

blocks.en: A critical design goal of OmniCapBench is to provide fine-grained, decoupled diagnostic signals. To validate that our deep-structured atomic units measure distinct capabilities rather than redundant phenomena, we computed the instance-level (per-video) Pearson correlation among the metrics across all 786 test videos, using the predictions of Gemini 3.1-Pro. As illustrated in Figure B.1 , we separate these into two distinct domains: Structural Metrics and Semantic Metrics.
blocks.zh: Omni Cap Bench的关键设计目标是提供精细的,脱钩的诊断信号. 为了验证我们深层结构的原子单位测量不同的能力而不是多余的现象,我们计算了实例水平(每视频) 皮尔逊在所有786个测试视频的测量值之间的相关性,使用双子座3.1-Pro的预测. 如图B.1所说明的,我们将这些分类分为两个不同的领域:结构计量和语义计量。

blocks.en: The Structural Metrics Correlation heatmap reveals that fundamental spatial, temporal, and cross-modal capabilities are highly decoupled. For instance, the correlation between Event F1 (audio perception) and Shot F1 (visual temporal grounding) is remarkably low ( r = 0.25 r=0.25 ), indicating that models often succeed in one modality while failing in the other. While EVSA (audio-visual association) naturally correlates with both its audio ( r = 0.67 r=0.67 ) and visual ( r = 0.62 r=0.62 ) prerequisites, complex tracking metrics remain isolated. CCC (cross-shot tracking) shows almost no correlation with basic temporal grounding ( Shot F1 , r = 0.17 r=0.17 ), proving that locating an action in time is fundamentally separate from persistently tracking the actor’s identity across discontinuous cuts.
blocks.zh: 结构计量相关热图显示,基本空间、时间和跨模式能力高度脱钩。 例如,事件F1(音频感知)和Shot F1(视觉时间定位)之间的关联性非常低(r = 0.25 r = 0.25),表明模型往往在一种模式下成功,而在另一种模式下失败。 虽然EVSA(视听协会)与其音频(r = 0.67 r = 0.67)和视觉(r = 0.62 r = 0.62)的前提条件自然相关,但复杂的跟踪指标仍然孤立。 CCC(交叉射击跟踪)显示与基本时间定位(Shoot F1, r = 0.17 r = 0.17)几乎没有关联性,证明及时定位某项行动与持续跟踪行为体的身份,通过断断续续的切入,根本是分开的.

blocks.en: The Semantic Metrics Correlation heatmap yields an equally crucial insight: descriptive fidelity is heavily fragmented. Strikingly, Subject Precision and Subject Recall exhibit zero correlation ( r = − 0.03 r=-0.03 ). This proves that a model’s tendency to hallucinate vivid details (low precision) is completely decoupled from its ability to comprehensively cover all ground-truth facts (recall). Furthermore, cross-domain semantic scores, such as Audio descriptions versus Scene Recall ( r = − 0.02 r=-0.02 ), are entirely uncorrelated. This quantitative analysis confirms that OmniCapBench’s suite of metrics effectively isolates distinct multimodal capabilities, exposing localized failures (e.g., severe hallucination despite high recall) that holistic scalars seamlessly average away.
blocks.zh: 语义计量关联热图产生同样至关重要的洞察力:描述性的忠诚程度严重分散。 Strikingly,主题精度和主题召回显示0相关(r=-0.03 r=-0.03). 这证明一个模型对生动细节产生幻觉的倾向(低精度)与它全面覆盖所有地真相的能力(回顾)完全脱节. 此外,跨域语义分数,如Audio描述与Scene Recall(r = − 0.02 r = - 0.02)完全无关. 这一定量分析证实,Omni Cap Bench的一套衡量标准有效地隔离了独特的多式联运能力,暴露了局部的失败(例如,尽管召回率很高,但出现了严重的幻觉),即整体的平平无缝。

blocks.en: Figure B.1 : Instance-level correlation among diagnostic metrics. Pearson correlation coefficients computed across 786 videos (Gemini 3.1-Pro). Left: Structural correlations confirm that complex capabilities like identity tracking ( CCC ) are decoupled from basic temporal grounding ( Shot F1 , r = 0.17 r=0.17 ). Right: Semantic LLM-as-judge scores exhibit near-zero correlation between Precision and Recall for Subject descriptions ( r = − 0.03 r=-0.03 ), proving that hallucination tendency and factual coverage are independent failure modes.
blocks.zh: 图B.1:诊断指标之间的实例水平关联。 在786个视频中计算出皮尔逊相关系数(Gemini 3.1-Pro)。 左:结构相关性证实身份跟踪(CC)等复杂能力与基本时间地平线脱钩(Shot F1,r=0.17 r=0.17. 右:语义LLM-as-judge分数显示精度和回想主题描述(r = − 0.03 r =- 0.03)之间近乎零相关,证明幻觉倾向和事实覆盖是独立的失败模式.

blocks.en: B.2 Detailed Setup
blocks.zh: B.2 详细设置

blocks.en: In Section 4 , we argue that traditional dense caption evaluation using text-centric metrics can falsely equate distinct models. To empirically validate this claim, we conducted an experiment using cases from the UGC-VideoCap [ 43 ] and video-SALMONN 2 [ 34 ] benchmarks, both of which rely on whole-caption evaluation paradigms.
blocks.zh: 在第4节中,我们争辩说,使用以文字为中心的衡量标准进行传统的密集标题评价可能错误地等同于不同的模式。 为了在经验上证实这一说法,我们利用UGC-VideoCap[43]和Video-SALMONN 2[34]基准的案例进行了试验,这两个基准都依赖于全封式评价范式。

blocks.en: Specifically, we constructed a diagnostic subset of 200 videos to serve as a “blind spot” dataset for traditional metrics. The construction followed these steps: 1. Source Log Analysis: We collected the dense caption outputs and corresponding global text-level scores for distinct frontier and open-source models evaluated on UGC-VideoCap and video-SALMONN 2. 2. Filtering for Pseudo-Equivalence: We computed the variance in the text-level scores among the models for each individual video. We then specifically filtered for cases where the maximum score difference between models was strictly less than 10 % 10\% . 3. Subset Construction: We sampled 200 such cases to form our final test set. By definition, traditional global text scoring evaluates these models as exhibiting nearly identical performance on this subset. 4. Structured Re-Evaluation: Finally, we evaluated the models’ structural comprehension on these exact 200 videos using OmniCapBench’s deep-structured atomic unit metrics.
blocks.zh: 具体来说,我们构建了由200个视频组成的诊断子集,作为传统度量衡的“盲点”数据集。 施工遵循这些步骤: 1. 源数据分析: 我们收集了在UGC-VideoCap和Video-SALMONN 2上评价的不同前沿和开源模型的密集字幕输出和相应的全球文本级别分数。 2. Pseudo-等效的过滤: 我们计算每个视频的模型中文本级别分数的差异。 然后我们专门过滤模型的最大得分差 绝对小于10%的10分 3. 子集建筑: 我们抽取了200个这样的病例 来做最后测试 顾名思义,传统的全球文本评分评价这些模型在这一子集上的表现几乎相同. 4. 结构重新评价: 最后,我们用Omni Cap Bench的深层原子单位度量来评估模型对这些精确的200个视频的结构理解。

blocks.en: As discussed in the main text and shown in Table B.7 , while the models appeared identical under global text scoring, OmniCapBench’s localized metrics revealed significant underlying quality gaps. This confirms that global text metrics frequently reward linguistically fluent but structurally flawed outputs, degrading diagnostic resolution.
blocks.zh: 如正文所讨论和表B.7所显示的,虽然在全球文本评分下这些模型似乎完全相同,但OmniCap Bench的本地化衡量标准揭示出存在重大的质量差距。 这证实,全球文本衡量标准往往在语言流利但结构有缺陷的输出中奖励降低诊断分辨率。

blocks.en: B.3 Full Main Results
blocks.zh: B.3 全部主要成果

blocks.en: While the main text presents compact metric families to highlight macro-level capability gaps, rigorous diagnostic evaluation requires exposing the underlying structural submetrics. This section provides the fully expanded results for all evaluated models. Tables B.2 and B.3 separate the rule-based compact columns into their constituent Precision, Recall, F1, and tIoU components. For instance, expanding the Audio dimension reveals whether a low Event F1 score is driven by hallucination (low precision) or omission (low recall). Table B.4 reports the localized LLM-as-judge scores across specific descriptive fields. Finally, Tables B.5 and B.6 stratify performance by video duration ( < 1 <1 min, 1 1 – 3 3 min, and 3 3 – 5 5 min), testing whether models maintain identity persistence and temporal grounding over extended contexts. Numeric tables use the same column-wise bold / underline convention as the main paper (best and second-best, ties allowed).

blocks.en: By unpacking the compact F1 scores into their base Recall and Precision constituents, we uncover distinct behavioral paradigms across the models. blocks.en: In the Audio-Visual domain (Table B.3 ), the expanded EVSA (Event-Shot Association) metric isolates the cross-modal bottleneck. Gemini 3.1-Pro’s EVSA Precision is high (78.35%): when the model does link an audio event to a visual shot, the topological link is usually correct.
