blocks.en: B.4 Case Studies
blocks.zh: B.4 个案研究

blocks.en: Our core motivation is to evaluate video captions through explicit, verifiable units rather than through a single holistic text score. This section presents two qualitative case studies that illustrate what this structured representation makes observable. The first case focuses on identity persistence : whether a model uses the same entity identifier for the same visual subject across temporally separated shots. The second case focuses on event-shot association : whether a recognized audio event is linked to the visual shot that supports its source. Together, these examples show how OmniCapBench turns broad caption quality into localized diagnostic evidence.
blocks.zh: 我们的核心动机是通过明确、可核查的单位而不是通过单一的整体文本评分来评价视频字幕。 本节介绍两项定性案例研究,说明这种结构化的表述方式可观察到什么。 第一个案例侧重于身份持久性:一个模型是否在时间上分离的镜头中为同一个视觉主体使用相同的实体标识. 第二个案例侧重于事件-shot关联:一个公认的音频事件是否与支持其来源的视觉镜头相关. 这些例子共同显示了Omni Cap Bench如何将广义标题质量转化为局部诊断证据。

blocks.en: B.4.1 Identity Persistence: Cross-Shot Coreference Consistency
blocks.zh: B.4.1 身份持久性:相互交会一致性

blocks.en: Cross-Shot Coreference Consistency (CCC) measures whether a model maintains a stable identity assignment for the same entity across multiple shots. This is different from detecting that a person or object appears somewhere in the video. A model may recognize the entity locally in each shot, but still fragment the entity into different identifiers after viewpoint changes, occlusions, or temporal gaps. CCC therefore evaluates whether the predicted reference graph is temporally consistent.
blocks.zh: 跨 Shot Coreference Consistency(CCC) 测量一个模型在多个镜头中是否保持同一实体的稳定身份分配. 这不同于侦测录像中某个人或物体出现的地方. 一个模型可能在每个镜头中就地识别该实体,但仍会将实体分解成不同识别符,在视角变化,被隔离,或时间间隔后. 因此,核心承诺评价预测参考图是否在时间上一致。

blocks.en: Figure B.2 : Case study of identity persistence measured by CCC. The timeline compares identity assignments across models over the same video interval. Colored spans show ground-truth and predicted identity coverage. Higher CCC indicates more consistent cross-shot identity reuse; lower CCC indicates identity fragmentation. In this case, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus score 76.92, 78.10, and 80.00, while Qwen3-Omni-Instruct scores 30.77, revealing a clear failure in preserving identity continuity.
blocks.zh: 图B.2:核心CC测量的识别持久性案例研究。 该时间表比较了同一视频间隔跨模型的身份分配。 彩色跨度显示地面真相和预计身份覆盖。 较高的CCC表示更一致地交叉射击身份再利用;较低的CCC表示身份破碎. 在这种情况下,双子座3.1 Pro,双子座2.5 Pro,和Quen3.5-OMNI-Plus的分数分别为76.92分,78.10分和80.00分,而Quen3-OMNI-Instruct的分数为30.77分,揭示了在维护身份连续性方面的明显失败.

blocks.en: Figure B.2 shows that CCC provides a direct diagnostic signal for identity persistence. The key comparison is not whether a model can mention the visible subject, but whether it preserves the same identity assignment over time. In the displayed example, three models maintain relatively consistent identity traces, with CCC scores above 76, while Qwen3-Omni-Instruct obtains 30.77. This indicates that its prediction is more fragmented at the structural level. The implication is that CCC isolates a specific failure mode: identity drift across the video timeline. This failure would be difficult to identify from a fluent caption alone, because a paragraph can describe the visible subject in each shot without exposing whether the model has maintained a stable entity graph.
blocks.zh: 图B.2显示,CCC为身份持久性提供了直接诊断信号. 关键比较不是一个模型是否能够提及可见主体,而是它是否随着时间的推移保留同一身份分配. 在所展示的例子中,有3个型号保持了相对一致的身份痕迹,CCC得分高于76分,而Qune3-Omni-Instruct则获得30.77分. 这表明其预测在结构层面较为分散. 其含义是CCC隔离出一个特定的故障模式:身份漂移到视频时间段. 单从一个流利的字幕中很难识别这种失败,因为一段可以描述每个镜头中的可见主题而不会暴露模型是否保持了稳定的实体图.

blocks.en: B.4.2 Audio-Visual Association: Event-Shot Association
blocks.zh: B.4.2 视听协会:活动-热会

blocks.en: Event-Shot Association (EVSA) evaluates a different type of structure. It checks whether each audio event is linked to the visual shot or shots that support its source. This distinction matters because recognizing an audio category and grounding that audio category in the concurrent visual timeline are different capabilities. A model may detect that a dialogue or mechanical sound exists, but still omit the shot-level edge that makes the audio source verifiable.
blocks.zh: Event-Shot Association(EVSA)评价不同类型结构. 它检查每个音频事件是否与支持其来源的视觉镜头相接. 这种区分很重要,因为承认一个音频类别,并将该音频类别置于并行的视觉时间表中,是不同的能力。 一个模型可能检测出一个对话框或机械声音存在,但仍会省略出使音频源可以核查的镜头级边缘.

Audio events: • DIALOGUE_1 [0.0–9.8]: PERSON_1 speaks in an instructional tone. • SFX_1 [5.5–8.0]: mechanical whirring and rhythmic geared turning. Ground-truth event-shot links: DIALOGUE_1 → \rightarrow Shots 1–5; SFX_1 → \rightarrow Shot 4. blocks.en: This case study shows why EVSA is evaluated as explicit event-shot edges rather than as part of a holistic caption score. The dialogue event spans almost the full clip and should therefore be linked to all five shots. This is an easy relation to hide in prose, because a caption can simply state that a person is explaining the process throughout the video. EVSA makes the requirement explicit: each covered shot must be represented as a separate verifiable edge. The mechanical sound is more localized. It occurs from 5.5 to 8.0 seconds and is supported by Shot 4, so missing SFX_1 → \rightarrow Shot 4 indicates an omission of a short cross-modal relation, while predicting SFX_1 → \rightarrow Shot 3 indicates temporal over-extension. The six model traces therefore expose three distinct behaviors: Gemini 3.1-Pro recovers the full graph, Gemini 2.5-Pro and Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus miss the localized SFX edge, and the remaining Qwen variants either truncate the long dialogue coverage or add an unsupported neighboring SFX edge.
blocks.zh: 本案例研究显示,为什么EVSA被评价为明显的事件镜头边缘而不是整体标题分数的一部分. 对话活动几乎跨越了整个片段,因此应当与所有五个镜头联系起来。 这是一个很容易隐藏在道具中的关系,因为一个标题可以简单地说明一个人在整个视频中解释这一过程. EVSA明确了要求:每个被覆盖的镜头必须作为单独的可核查的边缘来表示. 机械音比较本地化. 它从5.5秒到8.0秒 由Shoot 4支持 所以缺失的 SFQQ 1 ~ 右转 第4个镜头表示省略了短暂的跨模式关系,而预测的SFQQ 1 ~\正弦相接 第3镜头表示时间超长. 6个模型跟踪因此暴露出三个截然不同的行为:双子座 3.1-Pro恢复了完整的图,双子座 2.5-Pro和Quen3.5-OMNI-Plus错过了本地化的SFX边缘,而其余的Quen变体要么截断了长对话覆盖,要么增加了一个不支持的相邻SFX边缘.

blocks.en: Taken together, CCC and EVSA reveal two complementary forms of structured video understanding. CCC tests whether a visual entity remains the same node across discontinuous shots; EVSA tests whether an audio event is attached to the correct visual evidence in the timeline. Both metrics convert a fluent caption into checkable graph constraints. The resulting insight is that current models can often describe local content, but still fail when the evaluation asks whether references and events are consistently bound across time and modality. This is precisely the failure mode that a global caption-quality score would tend to smooth over.
blocks.zh: 综上所述,CCS和EVSA揭示了两种相辅相成的结构化视频理解形式. CCC测试一个视觉实体是否在不连续镜头中保持相同的节点;EVSA测试一个音频事件是否附在了时间表中正确的视觉证据上. 这两个度量衡将流畅的字幕转换为可校验的图表限制. 由此产生的见解是,目前的模型往往可以描述当地内容,但当评价问到参考文献和事件是否始终是跨越时间和方式的。 这正是全球字幕质量分数往往会平缓的失败模式。

blocks.en: B.5 Analysis of Specialized Captioning Models
blocks.zh: B.5 专门说明模型分析

blocks.en: As stated in Section 4.1 , we purposefully excluded highly specialized video-captioning models (such as ASID-Caption [ 25 ] , AVoCaDO [ 6 ] , TimeChat-Captioner [ 59 ] , and UGC-VideoCaptioner [ 43 ] ) from the primary capability benchmarking. This exclusion is not because these models are incapable of perceiving videos, but because their rigorous supervised fine-tuning (SFT) heavily biases them toward generating free-form, holistic text paragraphs.
blocks.zh: 正如第4.1节所指出,我们故意将高度专业化的视频封装模型(例如ASID-Caption [25]、AVoCaDO [6]、TimeChat-Captioner [59]和UGC-Video Captioner[43])排除在主要能力基准之外。 这种排除并不是因为这些模型无法看到视频,而是因为其严格的有监督的微调(SFT)使它们严重偏向于产生自由的、全面的文本段落。

blocks.en: This intensive, domain-specific linguistic alignment degrades their general instruction-following capabilities in ways that are visible before any semantic scoring is applied. When required to output the deep-structured atomic units of OmniCapBench (i.e., a structured JSON with Reference, Event, and Shot arrays), representative outputs show four recurring failure modes, separated into instruction-following failures in Figure B.3 and structural-output failures in Figure B.4 :
blocks.zh: 这种密集的、专有域的语言相接,在应用任何语义评分之前,会以可见的方式降低其一般的教学跟踪能力。 当需要输出Omni Cap Bench的深层结构原子单位(即结构化的JSON有参考、事件和Shot阵列)时,代表性产出显示四种反复出现的故障模式,在图B.3中分为指令后故障和图B.4中的结构输出故障:

blocks.en: • Schema rejection: ASID-Caption models often ignore the JSON contract, emitting timestamped prose. In one 17.1-second clip, the raw response repeats its description template until At 1037s , while the parsed references , events , and shots arrays remain empty (Figure B.3 (a)). • Fixed caption schema: TimeChat-Captioner does produce machine-readable JSON, but it follows its own captioning template with fields such as timestamp , segment_detail_caption , camera_state , storyline , and shooting_style . These fields are fluent but do not instantiate the OmniCapBench evaluation graph: there are no persistent reference IDs, no event objects, and no shot-level cross-modal links (Figure B.3 (b)). • Incomplete graph construction: AVoCaDO superficially follows the requested key names, producing two references and two shots, but leaves events empty, assigns repeated zero-length sub_shot_time spans, and links shots to an undefined SCENE_1 . The resulting object is a caption-like shot summary rather than a connected Reference–Event–Shot graph (Figure B.4 (a)). • Degenerate structured output: UGC-VideoCaptioner also emits target keys, but the structure is not usable. It repeatedly assigns sub_shot_time=[0.0,0.0] and restates near-identical subject facts such as [PERSON_1] is wearing a white shirt and blue jeans or [PERSON_1] is holding a metal tool to remove honeycomb frames (Figure B.4 (b)).

The outputs either cannot be parsed into OmniCapBench units, follow a model-specific caption template, or collapse the temporal event graph into disconnected, repeated fragments. Reporting downstream structural scores would therefore conflate video perception with schema compliance; we instead treat these traces as evidence that caption-specialized SFT does not provide the controllable, graph-structured generation required by OmniCapBench.

blocks.en: Table B.7 : The illusion of global text scores. We construct two hard-to-distinguish subsets where a weaker baseline and a stronger upgraded model exhibit near-identical text-centric scores. Across these pairs, we track performance through progressive strictness: (1) traditional text-centric metrics on dense captions, (2) strict structural verification using our native atomic units, and (3) human audit. Global text metrics falsely penalize the stronger models and overestimate the weaker ones, creating an illusion of parity. However, evaluating structural constraints directly resolves this gap, perfectly aligning with human judgment.
blocks.zh: 表B.7:全球文本分数的错觉. 我们构建了两个难以分辨的子集,其中较弱的基线和较强的升级模型呈现出近乎相同的以文字为中心的分数. 通过这些对子,我们通过渐进的严格性来跟踪性能:(1) 以文字为中心的传统指标在密集标题上,(2) 使用我们的原生原子单位进行严格的结构核查,(3) 人力审计。 全球文本衡量标准错误地惩罚了较强的模型并高估了较弱的模型,造成了一种平等幻想。 然而,对结构性制约因素的评估直接解决了这一差距,完全符合人类的判断。

blocks.en: B.6 Post-hoc Parsing Baseline
blocks.zh: B.6 事后分析基线

blocks.en: Appendix B.5 shows that prose-optimized captioners cannot emit OmniCapBench units directly, which raises a fair question: do their low scores measure perception, or only instruction following? To separate the two, we add a fixed post-hoc track. A single LLM parser receives the model’s free-form caption and never the video, converts that caption into OmniCapBench units, and marks unsupported fields as unknown (Listing B.2). The parser is identical for every model, so it contributes no visual evidence and no per-model tuning.
blocks.zh: 附录B.5显示,亲善字幕者不能直接放出OmniCap Bench单元,这就提出了一个合理的问题:他们的低分数是衡量感知,还是只按照指示进行? 为了将两者分开,我们增加了固定的后热轨道. 单 LLM 解析器接收到模型的自由格式标题,而永不播放视频,将标题转换为Omni Cap Bench 单元,并标记不支持的字段为未知(Listing B.2). 解析器对每个模型都是一样的,因此它不提供视觉证据,也不提供每个模型的调取.

blocks.en: Tables B.8 and B.9 show that this route buys format compliance, not information. Structural well-formedness rises: SGC improves from 97.36 to 99.19 for Gemini 3.1-Pro, and Shot F1 and Shot tIoU exceed 95 for every post-hoc entry, because a text-only parser emits clean, non-overlapping segments by construction. Every metric that requires grounding to the video degrades at the same time. Gemini’s CCC falls from 34.43 to 5.20 and its EVSA from 51.46 to 38.29, Qwen3-Omni-Instruct’s Event F1 falls from 41.70 to 12.82, and the localized semantic scores drop across the board, for instance Gemini’s Shot score from 59.05 to 35.84. This joint pattern is itself a diagnostic result: near-saturated shot metrics paired with single-digit CCC is precisely the profile that a global caption score hides and that our deep-structured units are built to expose.
blocks.zh: 表B.8和B.9显示,该路由购买格式合规性,而不是信息. 结构造型良好:SGC改进了双子座3.1-Pro的97.36-99.19,而Shoot F1和Shoot tIoU每入后都超过95个,因为只有文本解析器会通过构造释放出干净,不相重叠的片段. 每一个需要固定在视频上的度量都会同时降解. 双子座的CCC从34.43降至5.20,其EVSA从51.46降至38.29,Qune3-Omni-Instruct的F1事件从41.70降至12.82,本地语义分数全面下降,例如双子座的Shot分数从59.05降至35.84. 这种联合图案本身就是一个诊断结果: 近饱和的射击量度与一位数的CCC配对,正是全球字幕分数隐藏的特征,我们深层结构的单位是用来曝光的.

blocks.en: The post-hoc track also makes specialized captioners evaluable instead of simply scoring them zero. ASID-Captioner-7B now produces valid units and reaches 96.17 SGC, yet stays at 9.65 CCC, 11.09 Event F1, and 10.87 EVSA. Format repair therefore widens the benchmark’s coverage, but the cross-shot identity and audio-visual relations that OmniCapBench targets are absent from the original dense captions and cannot be reconstructed after the fact.
blocks.zh: 后浩克音轨也使得专业字幕器具有可评价性,而不是简单地给它们打零分. ASID-Captioner-7B现生产有效单位并达到96.17 SGC,但停留在9.65 CCC, 11.09事件F1和10.87 EVSA. 因此,格式修补扩大了基准的覆盖范围,但OmniCap Bench目标在最初的密集标题中缺失的交叉镜头身份和视听关系,无法事后重建。

blocks.en: Table B.8 : Native generation vs. the post-hoc parsing track (rule-based metrics). Native asks the model for OmniCapBench units directly; Post-hoc lets the model write a free-form caption that a fixed, video-blind LLM parser converts into units. Post-hoc raises structural well-formedness (SGC, Shot F1, Shot tIoU) while every grounding-dependent metric (CCC, Event F1, EVSA) degrades, showing that format repair does not recover information the caption never contained.
blocks.zh: 表B.8: 土著一代对浩克后解析轨迹(基于规则的度量衡). 土著直接询问 Omni Cap Bench 单元的模型; Post-hoc 让模型写一个自由形式的标题, 一个固定的, 视频盲的 LLM 解析器会转换成单元 。 后高分提高结构造型良好(SGC, Shot F1, Shot tIoU),而每个地基依赖度量(CCC, Event F1, EVSA)则会降解,显示格式修补无法取回从未包含的字幕信息.

blocks.en: Table B.9 : Native generation vs. the post-hoc parsing track (localized LLM-judge metrics). Every local semantic score drops under post-hoc conversion, including for the caption-specialized model that the track is meant to accommodate. Precision rises on some fields only because the parser emits fewer, more conservative units.
blocks.zh: 表B.9: 土著一代与高级后剖析轨迹(地方化的LLM-判断尺度)。 每个本地语义分数在后荷克转换下下降,包括赛道本意所适应的字幕专用模式. 精度在某些字段上上升,只是因为剖析器的出数较少,更保守.

blocks.en: B.7 Threshold Sensitivity
blocks.zh: B.7 临界敏感性

blocks.en: OmniCapBench fixes four matching cutoffs (Table A.5 ): non-dialogue event tIoU ≥ 0.20 \geq 0.20 , shot tIoU ≥ 0.30 \geq 0.30 , subshot window δ = 1.0 \delta=1.0 s, and dialogue 1 − WER ≥ 0.50 1-\mathrm{WER}\geq 0.50 . Since these values decide which predictions count as matched, we test whether our conclusions survive perturbation. We vary one cutoff at a time over the grid in Table B.10 for the six models listed there, holding predictions, references, and the one-to-one matching rule fixed, so no inference is re-run and only the alignment decision changes.
blocks.zh: Omni Cap Bench 修正了四个相匹配的切入点(表A.5):非对话事件 tIoU 0.20\geq 0.20,拍摄 tIoU 0.30\geq 0.30,子shot窗口 = 1.0\delta=1.0 s,和对话框 1 - WER − 0.50 1-\ mathrm{ WER}\geq 0.50 (英语). 由于这些数值决定了哪些预测是匹配的,所以我们测试我们的结论是否还存在扰动. 我们一次在表B.10的网格上对上面列出的六个模型进行一个截断,持有预测,引用,以及一对一匹配规则固定,所以没有再推论,只有对等决定改变.

blocks.en: Absolute scores move as expected—tightening shot tIoU from 0.30 to 0.50 costs Gemini 3.1-Pro 12.2 Shot F1 points—but the induced ranking does not. Spearman’s ρ \rho against the default, averaged over the two alternatives per sweep, is 1.000 for every metric except Shot F1 in the shot sweep (0.971) and Speaker in the dialogue sweep (0.914). No sweep produces a systematic open- versus closed-source reversal, and the only top-1 change within this set is a near tie on Speaker between Gemini 3.1-Pro (91.18) and Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus (91.20), two proprietary models 0.02 points apart. The structural bottlenecks we report, CCC and EVSA, are therefore properties of the evaluated models rather than artifacts of a particular cutoff.

blocks.en: Appendix C Limitations and Broader Impact
blocks.zh: 附录C 限制和更广泛的影响

blocks.en: Scoring atomic units rather than holistic text carries inherent limitations. First, OmniCapBench evaluates structural fidelity against our annotated reference system 𝒮 ⋆ ​ ( V ) \mathcal{S}^{\star}(V) , not every true fact in a video. A valid but peripheral detail outside our annotation scope therefore goes uncredited, a limitation shared by many generative benchmarks. Second, the dataset is bounded to videos under five minutes; far longer videos may require identity-tracking architectures beyond our scope. Third, the Stage II drafts seeding our reference system come from frontier models, some in the families we later evaluate, so an evaluator–model bias cannot be excluded: a reference inherits whatever blind spot survived review, and a model sharing the drafter’s stylistic priors may be scored slightly generously. We mitigate this by drafting with several model families, letting deterministic validators and human annotators arbitrate every unit (Appendix A.1.1 ), and restricting the scoring contract to locally verifiable fields, but we do not claim the bias is fully eliminated.
blocks.zh: 校正原子单位而不是整体文本具有固有的局限性。 首先,Omni Cap Bench根据我们注解的参考系统S {(V)}\mathcal{S}^{\star}(V)来评价结构的忠诚性,而不是在视频中每一个真实的事实。 因此,在我们的说明范围之外,一个有效但无关紧要的细节是不可信的,这是许多基因基准的共同限制。 第二,数据集以不到5分钟的视频为界;更长的视频可能需要超出我们范围的身份跟踪架构. 第三,第二阶段的草案为我们的参考系统提供了种子,有些来自前沿模型,有些来自我们后来评价的家族,所以不能排除一个评价者-模型的偏好:一个参考物继承了任何盲点的回顾,一个分享起草者风格前科的模型可能略为慷慨。 我们通过与几个模范家庭一起起草,让确定性鉴定人和人力注释人仲裁每个单元(附录A.1.1),并将评分合同限制在当地可核查的领域,来缓解这种情况,但我们并不声称偏见被完全消除。

blocks.en: Finally, enforcing a strict, deep-structured JSON schema inherently disadvantages models heavily over-optimized for free-form prose (as discussed in Appendix B.5 ). This is a deliberate choice intended to encourage the research community to shift toward controllable, structured video generation rather than opaque text generation. OmniCapBench’s broader impact is providing developers with a highly auditable, traceable diagnostic tool, ensuring that future improvements in MLLMs represent genuine audio-visual reasoning rather than mere linguistic fluency.
blocks.zh: 最后,执行严格、结构深厚的JSON计划,其内在缺点模式对自由形式道具的高度优化(如附录B.5所讨论)。 这是一个有意的选择,旨在鼓励研究界转向可控、结构化的视频生成,而不是不透明的文本生成。 OmniCap Bench更广泛的影响是向开发者提供高度可审计的可追踪的诊断工具,确保MLLMs的未来改进代表真正的视听推理,而不仅仅是语言流利.

blocks.en: Appendix D Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 附录D 道德考虑

blocks.en: Constructing and releasing OmniCapBench raises ethical considerations around privacy, copyright, and the interpretation of diagnostic evaluations.
blocks.zh: 构建和释放Omni Cap Bench引起了关于隐私、版权和诊断评价解释的道德考虑。

blocks.en: Privacy and Consent: The benchmark curates videos from publicly accessible media platforms and existing academic datasets. Since video intrinsically contains faces, voices, and potentially sensitive personal expressions, we filter out harmful, explicit, or highly sensitive private content during validation. Researchers using OmniCapBench must strictly adhere to the privacy guidelines of the original source platforms.
blocks.zh: 隐私与同意:基准整理了来自公众可访问媒体平台和现有学术数据集的视频. 由于视频本质上包含面相,声音,以及潜在的敏感个人表达方式,因此我们在验证过程中过滤出有害,明确或高度敏感的私人内容. 使用Omni Cap Bench的研究人员必须严格遵守原始源平台的隐私准则.

blocks.en: Copyright and Fair Use: OmniCapBench respects intellectual property rights by not distributing raw video files. Instead, we distribute the structured annotations alongside deterministic download scripts pointing to the original public URLs. This keeps the benchmark within academic fair use while respecting creators’ distribution rights.
blocks.zh: 版权与公平使用:Omni Cap Bench通过不分发原始视频文件来尊重知识产权. 相反,我们分发结构化的说明,同时分发确定性下载脚本,指向原始公共URL。 这保持了学术公平使用的基准,同时尊重创作者的发行权。

blocks.en: Evaluation Bias and Capabilities: Our benchmark is explicitly designed to measure structured audio-visual understanding. Enforcing a strict, rule-based schema intrinsically disadvantages models optimized solely for free-form prose generation. It is ethically imperative to emphasize that OmniCapBench measures a specific, rigorous form of grounded reasoning. A low score on OmniCapBench highlights localized structural deficits, but it does not necessarily imply that a model is entirely incapable of generating helpful video summaries in more relaxed, open-ended conversational settings.
blocks.zh: 评价的缺陷和能力: 我们的基准明确是为了衡量结构化的视听理解。 强制实施严格,有章可循的内在劣势模式,仅为自由形态的道具生成而优化. 在道德上必须强调,Omni Cap Bench衡量一种具体、严格的有根据的推理形式。 Omni Cap Bench上的低分凸显出本地化的结构缺陷,但这并不一定意味着一个模型完全无法在更宽松,开放式的对话环境中生成有用的视频摘要.

blocks.en: Listing B.1: Zero-shot Generation Instruction Example for predicting OmniCapBench units. ⬇ You are an expert audio - visual video analyzer . Watch the video carefully and decompose its contents into a strict JSON structure containing three tracks : ‘ references ‘, ‘ events ‘, and ‘ shots ‘. 1. ‘ references ‘: List all persistent entities ( PERSON , OBJECT , SCENE ). Give each a unique ‘ ref_id ‘ ( e . g ., PERSON_1 ). Include a ‘ semantic_description ‘ and an ‘ appearance_anchor ‘ detailing their visual features . 2. ‘ events ‘: List all audio events . Give each an ‘ event_id ‘, a ‘ time_range ‘ [ start , end ] in seconds , and ‘ content ‘. If the event is spoken dialogue , include the exact transcribed ‘ line ‘. 3. ‘ shots ‘: Divide the video into non - overlapping temporal shots . For each shot , provide its ‘ time_range ‘, ‘ visual_description ‘, and lists of ‘ active_events ‘ ( referencing event_ids ) and ‘ references_in_shot ‘ ( referencing ref_ids ). Output ONLY valid JSON matching this schema . Do not include markdown formatting or conversational text .

Output format: first write <score>N</score> (N=1-5), then 2-3 short evidence bullets naming the hit/missed target facts.’
